title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
title_zh: RoboJEPA: 基于Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) 的世界模型

paragraphs.en: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA’s imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在世界模型已展现出预测未来状态和在实际世界中规划方面的卓越能力。 然而，在实践中，我们缺乏一种系统性的方法来评估其能力如何随模型规模、数据和计算资源的变化而扩展，这一开放性问题正在减缓该领域的研究进展。 在本项工作中，我们提出了 RoboJEPA——一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型，该模型在涵盖 12 种机器人形态的大型数据集上进行训练。 我们发现，RoboJEPA 的“想象误差”（即其潜在模拟产生的误差）与计算资源之间遵循二阶幂律关系，这使得我们能够在远超拟合该规律时所达到的规模上准确预测模型质量。 我们还进一步证明，下游机器人规划性能会随着计算资源的增加而可预测地提升，且“想象误差”与其存在强相关性，因此可作为实际机器人评估的可靠代理指标。 最后，我们展示了潜在世界模型能够以零样本方式部署为机器人智能体，通过规划朝向单一目标图像来在真实硬件上解决需要长期规划的复杂任务。 我们同时发布了所有模型检查点以及训练和机器人部署代码。 据我们所知，这是首个为基于真实机器人数据训练的多种形态机器人世界模型建立扩展规律的研究；而 RoboJEPA（含 80 亿个参数）则是迄今为止训练规模最大的 JEPA 预测模型。

paragraphs.en: Scaling has been one of the primary engines of recent progress in artificial intelligence. What makes scaling particularly actionable is predictability : empirical scaling laws relate a model’s loss to the amount of data, parameters, and compute used to train it, so that the return on an additional order of magnitude of compute can be forecast before it is spent ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) . This predictability turns scaling from a gamble into a science, it tells practitioners how large a model to train for a given budget, how much data to pair it with, and when returns will diminish. Scaling laws of this kind have been established across language models ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , generative modeling of images, video, and other modalities ( Henighan et al., 2020 ) , or semantic classification of images ( Zhai et al., 2022 ) . Comparatively little is known about whether, and how, the same scaling predictability holds for models of the physical world.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展规模一直是近期人工智能领域进步的主要驱动力之一。 使扩展规模具有实际可行性的关键在于其可预测性：经验性扩展定律将模型的损失与其训练所用的数据量、参数和计算资源相关联，因此可以在投入额外一个数量级的计算资源之前，就预测出该投入所能带来的回报（Kaplan 等，2020；Hoffmann 等，2022）。 这种可预测性使扩展规模从一种赌博转变为一种科学，它告诉从业者：在给定预算的情况下，应训练多大规模的模型、搭配多少数据，以及何时收益会开始递减。 这类扩展定律已在语言模型（Kaplan 等，2020；Hoffmann 等，2022）、图像、视频及其他模态的生成式建模（Henighan 等，2020），以及图像的语义分类（Zhai 等，2022）等领域得到验证。 相比之下，关于相同的扩展可预测性是否适用于物理世界模型，以及具体如何适用，目前所知甚少。

paragraphs.en: We study this question for world models in robotics. A world model is a learned model of environment dynamics that an agent can roll out to imagine future states and plan ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) . We focus on latent world models that predict and plan in a latent representation space ( Hafner et al., 2020 ; LeCun, 2022 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . Latent world models have shown the ability to plan toward goals specified at test time without the need of a task-specific policy ( Assran et al., 2025 ) . Previous latent world models are typically trained at a single scale, and how their quality changes with data, parameters, and compute has not been characterized ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Other studies, focusing on scaling, either target generative video and interactive-environment models outside of robot control ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2024 ; Hu et al., 2023 ) , or scale policies rather than world models ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Sartor and Thompson, 2024 ; Ai et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, our goal is to establish scaling laws for latent world models. This matters particularly in robotics, where high-quality interaction data is scarce and computationally expensive to collect: knowing which capabilities a world model will have at a given training-compute budget lets practitioners decide whether to invest in a larger model, more demonstrations, or more compute, and reveals when a data budget has been saturated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对机器人领域的世界模型研究这一问题。 世界模型是一种对环境动态的学习模型，智能体可以通过它模拟未来状态并进行规划（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018；Hafner 等，2023）。 我们关注潜在世界模型，这类模型在潜在表示空间中执行预测和规划（Hafner 等，2020；LeCun，2022；Assran 等，2025）。 潜在世界模型已被证明能够根据测试时指定的目标进行规划，而无需任务特定的策略（Assran 等，2025）。 以往的潜在世界模型通常在单一规模下训练，其质量随数据、参数和计算资源的变化规律尚未得到明确描述（Assran 等，2025；Hafner 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026）。 其他研究虽然聚焦于规模扩展，但要么针对机器人控制之外的生成视频和交互式环境模型（Bruce 等，2024；Google DeepMind，2024；Hu 等，2023），要么扩展策略而非世界模型（Lin 等，2025；Sartor 和 Thompson，2024；Ai 等，2025）。 相比之下，我们的目标是建立潜在世界模型的规模定律。 这在机器人领域尤为重要，因为高质量交互数据稀缺且收集成本高昂：了解在特定训练计算预算下世界模型将具备哪些能力，能让从业者决定是投资更大规模的模型、更多演示数据，还是更多计算资源，并揭示数据预算何时达到饱和。

paragraphs.en: To this end, this work introduces RoboJEPA , a family of action-conditioned latent joint-embedding predictive world models. We keep the training recipe deliberatly simple to focus on the scaling behavior. RoboJEPA is a feed-forward transformer that predicts the next latent state deterministically in a single forward pass. It is trained with a plain ℓ 1 \ell_{1} regression loss in the frozen encoder’s latent space. RoboJEPA operates in the representation space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) and is trained on a unified mixture of 23 public manipulation datasets spanning 12 embodiments and 26 different action spaces. We study model scaling of the world model , ranging parameter count from 22M up to 8B, while holding the representation encoder fixed, so our laws characterize how a plannable dynamics model scales on top of a shared representation. We build scaling laws estimating the compute-efficient frontier of the forward-prediction evaluation loss as a function of the training compute ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Pearce and Song, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为此，本研究提出了 RoboJEPA——一系列以动作条件化的潜在联合嵌入预测世界模型。 我们刻意保持训练流程的简单性，以便专注于其扩展行为。 RoboJEPA 是一种前馈式 Transformer，它能在单次前向传播中确定性地预测下一个潜在状态。 它在冻结编码器的潜在空间中，使用普通的 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 回归损失进行训练。 RoboJEPA 在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器的表示空间中运行（Assran et al., 2025; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026），并在一个统一混合的 23 个公开操控数据集上进行训练，这些数据集涵盖了 12 种实体形态和 26 种不同的动作空间。 我们研究了世界模型的模型扩展性，参数数量从 22M 到 8B 不等，同时保持表示编码器固定不变，因此我们的定律描述了可规划动态模型在共享表示之上的扩展方式。 我们构建了扩展定律，用于估算前向预测评估损失在计算效率前沿上的表现，并将其表示为训练计算量的函数（Kaplan et al., 2020; Pearce and Song, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Our central finding is that robotic world-model quality scales predictably with compute. First, the latent forward-prediction loss on out-of-distribution data follows a scaling law L ⁡ ( C ) = A ​ C α − γ ​ ln ⁡ C + E L(C)=A\,C^{\alpha-\gamma\ln C}+E , where C C is the training compute, E E is the irreducible loss, and A , α , γ A,\alpha,\gamma are scaling-law parameters that we estimate alongside E E . This holds on both real-robot holdout (DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) ) data and simulated holdout (RoboCasa ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) ) data. Second, this improvement on the offline data transfers to downstream planning performance on a robot: on a suite of RoboCasa planning tasks, downstream success improves predictably with training compute, so that a world model’s latent forward-prediction loss is a strong predictor of its online planning performance. For example, only models trained with more than 10 22 10^{22} FLOPs of training compute (at sizes 2B, 4B, and 8B) can solve object-interaction tasks in RoboCasa via non-greedy planning, while smaller models trained with less compute cannot (see Figure 15 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心发现是，机器人世界模型的质量会随着计算量的增加而呈现出可预测的扩展趋势。 首先，在分布外数据上的潜在前向预测损失遵循一个扩展定律 L(C) = A C^{α−γ} ln C + E，其中 C 是训练计算量，E 是不可约损失，而 A、α、γ 是我们与 E 一同估计的扩展定律参数。 这一规律在真实机器人保留数据（DROID (Khazatsky et al., 2024)）和模拟保留数据（RoboCasa (Nasiriany et al., 2026)）上均成立。 其次，这种在离线数据上的改进会迁移到机器人的下游规划性能中：在一组 RoboCasa 规划任务中，下游任务的成功率会随着训练计算量的增加而可预测地提升，因此世界模型的潜在前向预测损失是其在线规划性能的强预测指标。 例如，只有使用超过 10^{22} FLOPs 训练计算量（在 2B、4B 和 8B 规模下）训练的模型，才能通过非贪心规划解决 RoboCasa 中的物体交互任务，而使用更少计算量训练的较小模型则无法做到这一点（参见图 15）。

sents.en: Our central finding is that robotic world-model quality scales predictably with compute.

sents.en: This holds on both real-robot holdout (DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) ) data and simulated holdout (RoboCasa ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) ) data.

sents.en: Second, this improvement on the offline data transfers to downstream planning performance on a robot: on a suite of RoboCasa planning tasks, downstream success improves predictably with training compute, so that a world model’s latent forward-prediction loss is a strong predictor of its online planning performance.
sents.zh: 其次，这种在离线数据上的改进会迁移到机器人的下游规划性能中：在一组 RoboCasa 规划任务中，下游任务的成功率会随着训练计算量的增加而可预测地提升，因此世界模型的潜在前向预测损失是其在线规划性能的强预测指标。

sents.en: For example, only models trained with more than 10 22 10^{22} FLOPs of training compute (at sizes 2B, 4B, and 8B) can solve object-interaction tasks in RoboCasa via non-greedy planning, while smaller models trained with less compute cannot (see Figure 15 ).
sents.zh: 例如，只有使用超过 10^{22} FLOPs 训练计算量（在 2B、4B 和 8B 规模下）训练的模型，才能通过非贪心规划解决 RoboCasa 中的物体交互任务，而使用更少计算量训练的较小模型则无法做到这一点（参见图 15）。

paragraphs.en: We deploy RoboJEPA on real and simulated robots, planning toward a single goal image that defines the final state of the environment. Across two robot platforms, we perform planning in over 50,000 50{,}000 evaluation episodes. We keep the planning hyperparameters fixed for each robot, varying only the planning horizon for harder tasks. We perform planning on a set of real world manipulation tasks that include grasping, lifting, and pick-and-place. In simulation, our planning spans tasks of increasing difficulty from reaching to object pushing. We observe an improvement trend in the success rate on the real robot as we increase the model size. Qualitatively, we also observe that the behavior of the planning policies changes as the model grows: for example, in object-manipulation tasks, only models with 2B parameters or more keep the gripper closed after grasping to complete the task, while smaller models often accidentally open it, dropping the object.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在真实机器人和模拟机器人上部署了 RoboJEPA，其规划目标是定义环境最终状态的单一目标图像。 在两种机器人平台上，我们进行了超过 50,000 个评估回合的规划。 我们为每个机器人保持规划超参数不变，仅在对更困难的任务中调整规划时间范围。 我们在一系列真实世界的操作任务上执行规划，这些任务包括抓取、提升以及抓取与放置。 在模拟环境中，我们的规划涵盖了从伸手到物体推动等不同难度等级的任务。 随着模型规模的增大，我们观察到真实机器人上的成功率呈现出上升趋势。 从定性角度来看，我们还发现规划策略的行为会随着模型规模的扩大而发生变化：例如，在物体操作任务中，只有参数规模达到 2B 或以上的模型会在抓取后保持夹爪闭合以完成任务，而规模较小的模型则常常意外打开夹爪，导致物体掉落。

paragraphs.en: Finally, to support open research and reproducibility, we release all model checkpoints together with the training and robot-deployment code. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to establish compute-optimal scaling laws for action-conditioned robotic world models trained on large-scale, multi-embodiment real robot data, and the first scaling law for JEPA with verified extrapolation. We also train the largest JEPA predictor to date, at 8B parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，为了支持开放研究和可重复性，我们公开了所有模型检查点以及训练和机器人部署代码。 据我们所知，这是首个为基于大规模多具身真实机器人数据训练的、以动作为条件的机器人世界模型建立计算最优扩展定律的研究，也是首个经过验证的外推能力的 JEPA 扩展定律。 我们还训练了迄今为止最大的 JEPA 预测器，参数规模达到 80 亿。

paragraphs.en: Scaling world models across robot datasets is challenging because each dataset comes with a different number of camera views, proprioceptive state size, and controller type and frequency. Therefore, we aim to build a world model architecture that can work with any combination of views, controller type, and proprioceptive information. At each timestep t t , a frozen V-JEPA 2.1-G encoder maps up to V V simultaneous camera views at resolution H × W H\times W , each spanning T T frames, denoted x t ( 1 : V ) = ( x t ( 1 ) , … , x t ( V ) ) x_{t}^{(1:V)}=(x_{t}^{(1)},\dots,x_{t}^{(V)}) , to the latent features z t ( 1 : V ) = ( z t ( 1 ) , … , z t ( V ) ) z_{t}^{(1:V)}=(z_{t}^{(1)},\dots,z_{t}^{(V)}) , where each z t ( v ) z_{t}^{(v)} is an H p × W p H_{p}\times W_{p} grid of D e D_{e} -dimensional patch embeddings with D e = 1664 D_{e}=1664 and H p = H / 16 H_{p}=H/16 , W p = W / 16 W_{p}=W/16 . We use V-JEPA 2.1 as the encoder because early in the work we found that it leads to successful and predictable scaling of the world model, whereas V-JEPA 2 does not (we hypothesize why in Appendix K ). Alongside these features, each timestep provides the action a t ∈ ℝ d a a_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{a}} and proprioceptive state s t ∈ ℝ d s s_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{s}} , while each input is associated with a robot type operating in a particular action space, identified by the robot id e ∈ ℰ e\in\mathcal{E} , and a per-view camera type c ( v ) ∈ 𝒞 c^{(v)}\in\mathcal{C} . Here, ℰ \mathcal{E} and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} are finite sets of known robot ids and camera types. Next we describe how we tokenize inputs, and the world model architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 将世界模型扩展到不同的机器人数据集具有挑战性，因为每个数据集的摄像头视角数量、本体感觉状态大小、控制器类型和频率都各不相同。 因此，我们的目标是构建一个能够适应任何视角组合、控制器类型和本体感觉信息的世界模型架构。 在每个时间步 t t 中，一个冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1-G 编码器将最多 V V 个同时运行的摄像头视角（分辨率为 H × W H\times W，每个视角包含 T T 帧）映射到潜在特征 z t ( 1 : V ) = ( z t ( 1 ) , … , z t ( V ) ) z_{t}^{(1:V)}=(z_{t}^{(1)},\dots,z_{t}^{(V)})，其中每个 z t ( v ) z_{t}^{(v)} 是一个 H p × W p H_{p}\times W_{p} 的网格，包含 D e D_{e} 维的块嵌入，且 D e = 1664 D_{e}=1664，H p = H / 16 H_{p}=H/16，W p = W / 16 W_{p}=W/16。 我们使用 V-JEPA 2.1 作为编码器，因为在研究初期我们发现，它能实现世界模型的成功且可预测的扩展，而 V-JEPA 2 则无法做到（我们在附录 K 中推测了原因）。 除了这些特征外，每个时间步还提供动作 a t ∈ ℝ d a a_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{a}} 和本体感觉状态 s t ∈ ℝ d s s_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{s}}；同时，每个输入都与一个在特定动作空间中运行的机器人类型相关联，该类型由机器人标识符 e ∈ ℰ e\in\mathcal{E} 表示，以及每个视角的摄像头类型 c ( v ) ∈ 𝒞 c^{(v)}\in\mathcal{C}。 此处，ℰ \mathcal{E} 和 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 分别是已知机器人标识符和摄像头类型的有限集合。 接下来我们将描述如何对输入进行分词，以及世界模型的架构。

paragraphs.en: Tokenization. We encode each modality separately and interleave the results into a single flat sequence. We refer to these encoded multimodal vectors as tokens. The motivation of our tokenization scheme is to let the model learn all temporal dependencies only from a structured sequence of tokens. To tokenize each z t ( v ) z_{t}^{(v)} , we project each patch from D e D_{e} to the world-model width D D with a single linear layer, giving a visual token tensor of shape [ T , V , H p , W p , D ] [T,V,H_{p},W_{p},D] . Actions and proprioceptive states are mapped to D D by linear encoders (specific to robot id) applied to a t a_{t} and s t s_{t} .

paragraphs.en: World Model Architecture. RoboJEPA performs the next embedding prediction via a deterministic model. RoboJEPA uses the vision transformer ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) as the backbone and we parameterize the prediction such that each spatial input token of z t ( 1 : V ) z_{t}^{(1:V)} predicts the corresponding spatial token of z t + 1 ( 1 : V ) z_{t+1}^{(1:V)} . We use the frame-level causal attention mask so that queries that correspond to timestep t t have only access to keys and values at step t t or earlier. The model stacks L L blocks that form a standard residual stream of ViT. The architecture of each block follows the standard recipe for modern variants of ViTs: we use pre-normalization, Rotary Position Encoding ( Su et al., 2024 ) , RMSNorm normalization ( Zhang and Sennrich, 2019 ) , GELU feed-forward block ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2016 ) , and QK-normalization ( Dehghani et al., 2023 ) . We found QK-normalization to be of particular importance for training stability when scaling the dataset size and the model size.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型架构。 RoboJEPA 通过一个确定性模型执行下一次嵌入预测。 RoboJEPA 使用视觉变换器（Dosovitskiy 等人，2021）作为主干网络，并将预测参数化为：z_t^{(1:V)} 的每个空间输入标记都预测 z_{t+1}^{(1:V)} 中对应的空间标记。 我们使用帧级因果注意力掩码，使得对应时间步 t 的查询只能访问时间步 t 或更早步骤的键和值。 该模型堆叠了 L 个模块，构成了 ViT 的标准残差流。 每个模块的架构遵循现代 ViT 变体的标准设计：我们使用了预归一化、旋转位置编码（Su 等人，2024）、RMSNorm 归一化（Zhang 和 Sennrich，2019）、GELU 前馈模块（Hendrycks 和 Gimpel，2016）以及 QK 归一化（Dehghani 等人，2023）。 我们发现，在扩大数据集规模和模型规模时，QK 归一化对训练稳定性尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: Factorized RoPE and view conditioning. The spatio-temporal position information is supplied by a multi-axis Rotary Position Embedding ( Su et al., 2024 ) that splits each head’s channels into four equal sub-blocks of width d h / 4 d_{h}/4 , one for each of the four axes ( t , i , j , v ) (t,i,j,v) for time, height, width, and view, where d h d_{h} is the head dimension. Our version of RoPE rotates each independently by its own per-axis frequency ( Section A.1 ). Action and state tokens have a temporal index but no spatial index, i.e. the 4D index of the action a t a_{t} would be ( t , 0 , 0 , 0 ) (t,0,0,0) . We combine this 4D RoPE with a per-layer learnable view bias applied after RoPE. The idea is that the 4D RoPE informs the model that tokens belong to different views, while the view bias informs the model which content each view holds (e.g. left camera, wrist camera; Section A.2 ). This allows us to randomize the order of views and at the same time provide the information which views the model works with.
paragraphs.zh: 因子分解的 RoPE 与视角条件化。 时空位置信息由多轴旋转位置嵌入（Su et al., 2024）提供，它将每个头的通道划分为四个宽度为 d h / 4 d_{h}/4 的相等子块，分别对应四个轴（t, i, j, v），即时间、高度、宽度和视角，其中 d h d_{h} 是头的维度。 我们版本的 RoPE 对每个轴独立旋转，使用其自身的每轴频率（A.1 节）。 动作和状态令牌具有时间索引，但没有空间索引，即动作 a t a_{t} 的 4D 索引为 (t, 0, 0, 0) (t,0,0,0)。 我们将这种 4D RoPE 与每层可学习的视角偏置相结合，该偏置在 RoPE 之后应用。 其核心思想是：4D RoPE 告知模型哪些令牌属于不同视角，而视角偏置则告知模型每个视角包含的内容（例如，左摄像头、手腕摄像头；A.2 节）。 这使得我们能够随机化视角的顺序，同时向模型提供其所处理的视角信息。

paragraphs.en: Attention pattern. We use joint space-time-view attention and do not factorize it, meaning that each token can have access to potentially all other tokens in the space-time-view sequence, unless restricted by the attention mask. However, using no mask would allow past token activations access future information that they need to predict. For example, token activations of z t z_{t} will have access to tokens of z t + 1 z_{t+1} in self-attention. Therefore, we use a timestep-causal mask ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Po et al., 2025 ; PAN Team et al., 2025 ) . That is, a query associated with timestep t t has access to keys only at timestep t t or less. This includes attention queries and keys associated with different views, actions, and states. In addition to that, we make the attention local by letting queries only access keys that are at most 8 8 timesteps in the past ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Po et al., 2025 ; PAN Team et al., 2025 ) . This design helps the model extrapolate to predicting longer sequences of embeddings because no query will ever attend to a history longer than the model was trained on, including during long autoregressive prediction. For implementation details on the attention masking, see Section A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 注意力模式。 我们使用联合时空视图注意力，并且不对它进行分解，这意味着除非受到注意力掩码的限制，否则每个标记都可以访问时空视图序列中潜在的所有其他标记。 然而，如果不使用任何掩码，过去的标记激活将能够访问它们预测所需的信息。 例如，z t z_{t} 的标记激活在自注意力中将能够访问 z t + 1 z_{t+1} 的标记。 因此，我们使用时步因果掩码（Assran et al., 2025；Po et al., 2025；PAN Team et al., 2025）。 也就是说，与时间步 t t 相关的查询只能访问时间步为 t t 或更早的键。 这包括与不同视图、动作和状态相关的注意力查询和键。 除此之外，我们通过让查询仅能访问最多早于当前 8 8 个时间步的键，使注意力具有局部性（Assran et al., 2025；Po et al., 2025；PAN Team et al., 2025）。 这种设计有助于模型外推预测更长的嵌入序列，因为没有任何查询会关注超过模型训练时所接触的历史长度，即使在长时间的自回归预测过程中也是如此。 关于注意力掩码的实现细节，请参见第 A.3 节。

paragraphs.en: Outputs. After feeding the entire sequence of tokens through the backbone, we project tokens that correspond to z ( 1 : V ) 1 : T z^{(1:V)}_{1:T} back to the encoder space. We map the output from D D dimensions to D e D_{e} dimensions and apply layer normalisation. The idea is that since both input and output features are normalized, this strenghtens the learning signal and lowers the gap between the training and the autoregressive generation. We do not use any learnable modules to predict states and we simply compute the proprioceptive state s t s_{t} either through integration, i.e. s t + 1 = s t + a t s_{t+1}=s_{t}+a_{t} , or s t = 0 s_{t}=0 (for example when working with commanded actions with non-trivial robot dynamics).

paragraphs.en: Training objective. We train the world model to predict the next embedding and, to minimize exposure bias, we additionally train it on its own outputs over potentially long horizons. Our objective therefore has two loss components. The first component trains the model to predict every next embedding along a sequence of encoded multiview frames. The second component uses the same objective, but the model is given only a prefix of fewer encoded frames (but the entire sequence of actions); it then predicts the missing embeddings autoregressively ( Equations 1 and 2 ) and is trained on them with the same objective. We use a key-value cache to speed up this autoregressive prediction ( Sections 2.2 and H ). While the first loss component ensures that the model predicts the representations of a fixed encoder, the second makes the world model robust to its own errors and suppresses error accumulation. Both components use the same per-token ℓ 1 \ell_{1} objective, and the total loss is their average:
paragraphs.zh: 训练目标。 我们训练世界模型以预测下一个嵌入表示，并且为了最小化暴露偏差，我们还让它在潜在较长的时间跨度内基于自身输出进行额外训练。 因此，我们的目标包含两个损失分量。 第一个分量训练模型预测编码多视角帧序列中的每一个下一个嵌入表示。 第二个分量使用相同的目标，但模型仅被给予较短的前缀编码帧（但完整的动作序列）；然后它自回归地预测缺失的嵌入表示（方程 1 和 2），并基于这些表示使用相同的目标进行训练。 我们使用键值缓存来加速这种自回归预测（第 2.2 节和第 H 节）。 虽然第一个损失分量确保模型能够预测固定编码器的表示，但第二个分量则使世界模型对自身的错误具有鲁棒性，并抑制错误累积。 两个分量都使用相同的每词元 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 目标，总损失为它们的平均值：

paragraphs.en: Data. Training a world model that generalizes across robot embodiments and scenes requires both scale and diversity. We assemble 23 23 public manipulation datasets spanning 12 12 robot platforms—single- and dual-arm robots and humanoids—across real and simulated data. The compiled dataset contains 15,022 15{,}022 hours of video, including 6,692 6{,}692 hours synchronized with actions; some demonstrations are recorded from multiple cameras. Some platforms record with only one camera (e.g. most of Open-X Embodiment data), whereas others use two or three cameras (e.g. DROID and RoboSet). In addition, the datasets were collected with different robot action spaces, camera poses, sensor resolutions, and frame rates. Therefore, to build a data-scalable world model, we unify our training datasets and formulate the architecture and training recipe to be general enough to work with any robotic dataset. Table 1 summarizes the mixture, and Appendix B provides further details about its action spaces, unification, and sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 数据。 训练一个能够跨机器人形态和场景泛化的世界模型，既需要大规模数据，也需要多样性。 我们整合了 23 个公开操作数据集，涵盖 12 种机器人平台——包括单臂、双臂机器人和人形机器人——以及真实与模拟数据。 整合后的数据集包含 15,022 小时视频，其中 6,692 小时与动作同步；部分演示来自多个摄像头的录制。 某些平台仅使用一个摄像头进行录制（例如 Open-X Embodiment 的大部分数据），而另一些则使用两到三个摄像头（例如 DROID 和 RoboSet）。 此外，这些数据集是在不同的机器人动作空间、摄像头姿态、传感器分辨率和帧率下采集的。 因此，为了构建一个数据可扩展的世界模型，我们对训练数据集进行了统一，并设计了足够通用的架构和训练方案，使其能够适用于任何机器人数据集。 表 1 总结了该混合数据集的构成，附录 B 提供了关于其动作空间、统一方法和采样的更多细节。

paragraphs.en: Training. We train a series of RoboJEPA models that range in size from 22 22 M to 8 8 B parameters and in training compute from 2 × 10 19 2{\times}10^{19} to 9.5 × 10 22 9.5{\times}10^{22} FLOPs. For all models, we use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with a weight decay of 0.1 0.1 and global gradient-norm clipping at 1.0 1.0 . We linearly warm up the learning rate, hold it constant at a peak of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for most of training, and then linearly decay it to zero over a short cooldown phase at the end ( Hu et al., 2024 ) . This allows us to overlap the flat learning-rate stage across models trained with different amounts of compute: we run the flat stage only once and perform learning-rate annealing from intermediate checkpoints. For the detailed description of the training configuration and hyperparameters, please refer to Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 训练。 我们训练了一系列 RoboJEPA 模型，其参数规模从 22 M 到 8 B 不等，训练计算量从 2 × 10^{19} FLOPs 到 9.5 × 10^{22} FLOPs。 对于所有模型，我们使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019），权重衰减为 0.1，全局梯度范数裁剪值为 1.0。 我们将学习率线性预热，在训练的大部分阶段保持其峰值为 5 × 10^{-5}，然后在最后的短暂冷却阶段将其线性衰减至零（Hu 等，2024）。 这使得我们可以在使用不同计算量的模型训练中重叠平坦学习率阶段：我们仅运行一次该平坦阶段，并从中间的检查点开始执行学习率退火。 有关训练配置和超参数的详细描述，请参阅附录 C。

paragraphs.en: The training recipe of RoboJEPA is designed to facilitate scaling the model on as much data as is available, which requires training on many heterogeneous robotic datasets at once. A central issue with such heterogeneous data is that some datasets supply only a single view while others provide multiple views, often at different resolutions. We therefore train the model to work with a variable number of views and a variable resolution. To achieve this, we partition the GPUs into groups, where all GPUs within a group work with the same number of views and the same resolution. In practice this often leads to imbalanced step times across groups, which is why we balance these times by using different batch sizes for different groups. Our initial scaling-law experiments were done at a resolution of 240 × 320 240\times 320 with only two GPU groups: one working with single-view data and the other with dual-view data. However, eventually we found it beneficial to include high-resolution GPU groups, resulting in four groups: single-view low-resolution ( 240 × 320 240\times 320 ), dual-view low-resolution, single-view high-resolution ( 480 × 640 480\times 640 ), and dual-view high-resolution. We describe the GPU grouping and batch-size balancing in detail in Sections C.1 and C.2 .
paragraphs.zh: RoboJEPA 的训练方案旨在促进模型在尽可能多的可用数据上进行扩展，这需要在一次训练中同时处理大量异构的机器人数据集。 这类异构数据的一个核心问题是：某些数据集仅提供单视角数据，而另一些则提供多视角数据，且视角分辨率通常各不相同。 因此，我们训练模型以应对不同数量的视角和不同的分辨率。 为实现这一点，我们将 GPU 划分为多个组，同一组内的所有 GPU 均使用相同数量的视角和相同的分辨率进行计算。 在实际应用中，这常常导致各组之间的步骤时间不均衡，因此我们通过为不同组设置不同的批量大小来平衡这些时间。 我们最初的缩放定律实验是在 240 × 320 的分辨率下进行的，仅使用了两个 GPU 组：一个处理单视角数据，另一个处理双视角数据。 然而，最终我们发现加入高分辨率的 GPU 组会更有利，因此最终形成了四个组：单视角低分辨率（240 × 320）、双视角低分辨率、单视角高分辨率（480 × 640）以及双视角高分辨率。 我们在 C.1 和 C.2 节中详细描述了 GPU 分组和批量大小平衡的方法。

paragraphs.en: Inference and Planning. RoboJEPA performs planning by predicting the future in the latent space and searching over the action sequence that brings that future to the desired goal. We employ receding-horizon CEM ( Rubinstein, 1997 ; de Boer et al., 2005 ) as our planning algorithm with image goals; importantly, we use only a single image goal that represents the final state of the task, and we do not use subgoals. Notably, we run all planning with the same set of hyperparameters across embodiments and tasks. This process requires running thousands of forward passes of the world model, which is prohibitively expensive if the full history is recomputed every step. Therefore, we employ a rolling KV-cache that reuses the keys and values of past steps in self-attention. This way, at every step the model only processes a single frame, action, and proprioceptive vector, while the past information is provided by the cache (see Appendix H ). Additionally, we employ PyTorch compilation to further speed up inference. However, in the typical planning scenario we need to run compiled inference during planning on the real robot, and since first-time compilation is time-consuming, running planning with compilation can become prohibitively slow in practice. This is why we build a simple inference engine that precompiles the inference computation and saves it to disk, and at planning time simply loads it back (see Section I.2 ). Finally, since CEM planning is heavily parallelizable, we connect the robot directly to the GPU cluster and run the planning on multiple GPUs. This way, we make the planning fast enough to be practical: while it is not real-time, it takes only several seconds to perform a multi-step planning even for an 8 8 B model.
paragraphs.zh: 推理与规划。 RoboJEPA 通过在潜在空间中预测未来，并搜索能将该未来状态引导至目标的动作序列来实现规划。 对于图像目标，我们采用滚动视界的 CEM（Rubinstein, 1997；de Boer et al., 2005）作为规划算法；重要的是，我们仅使用一个代表任务最终状态的图像目标，而不会使用子目标。 值得注意的是，我们在所有具身形态和任务中均使用相同的超参数集进行规划。 这一过程需要运行世界模型数千次前向传播，如果每一步都重新计算完整的历史信息，其成本将高得令人难以承受。 因此，我们采用滚动 KV-cache，在自注意力机制中重复利用过往步骤的键和值。 这样，在每一步中，模型只需处理单个帧、一个动作和一个本体感觉向量，而历史信息则由缓存提供（参见附录 H）。 此外，我们还使用 PyTorch 编译技术进一步加快推理速度。 然而，在典型的规划场景中，我们需要在真实机器人上运行经过编译的推理；由于首次编译耗时较长，实际中结合编译进行规划可能会变得极其缓慢。 因此，我们构建了一个简单的推理引擎，该引擎会预先编译推理计算并保存至磁盘，在规划时只需将其重新加载即可（参见第 I.2 节）。 最后，由于 CEM 规划具有高度的并行性，我们将机器人直接连接到 GPU 集群，并在多个 GPU 上运行规划。 这样，我们使规划足够快速以具备实际可行性：虽然并非实时，但即使对于 88B 模型，执行多步规划也仅需数秒。

paragraphs.en: To qualitatively understand the capabilities of our world models, we train a diffusion decoder that produces pixel outputs from the predicted features; its goal is to visualize the forward predictions of the world model. The decoder is a diffusion model ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ) that denoises the continuous video tokens of the Cosmos tokenizer ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) 1 1 1 Cosmos-CV4x8x8. spatially conditioned on the V-JEPA 2.1 features. The purpose of using a generative model here is that the decoder does not merely convert the V-JEPA features into Cosmos tokens, but also imagines unseen motion. During the training of the decoder, we compute V-JEPA features with a frame skip of 4 4 frames, whereas the Cosmos tokens compress the same frames without any frame skip. As a result, the Cosmos tokens contain more information than the original V-JEPA feature frames, and this extra information — precisely, the 3 3 RGB frames between consecutive frames encoded by the V-JEPA encoder — must be generated. With such a decoder, we can run forward prediction with the world model at, for example, 5 5 Hz actions, producing latent features at the same rate, and then use the decoder to expand them into an RGB stream at 20 20 FPS that covers exactly the same motion. Full architecture, training, and sampling details are in Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: Our goal is to empirically find the concrete functional form of the scaling law that allows us to extrapolate predictions about the performance of the RoboJEPA model trained at larger scales. We consider four candidate functional forms. First, the standard power law L ⁡ ( C ) = E + A ​ C α L(C)=E+A\,C^{\alpha} ( Henighan et al., 2020 ) , whose exponent α \alpha is constant. Second, a generalization whose exponent itself changes linearly with compute, L ⁡ ( C ) = E + A ​ C α − γ ​ ln ⁡ C L(C)=E+A\,C^{\alpha-\gamma\ln C} ; we refer to the former as a first-order and to the latter as a second-order power law 2 2 2 It is easy to show that, for the latter, the dependency between ln ⁡ ( L − E ) \ln(L-E) and ln ⁡ C \ln C is a quadratic function of ln ⁡ C \ln C . . Finally, the Broken ( Caballero et al., 2022 ) and Unified ( Caballero et al., 2026 ) Neural Scaling Laws. Here, C C is the total training compute (in FLOPs) and L ⁡ ( C ) L(C) is the world model’s forward-prediction error, i.e. the per-token ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance between the predicted and the encoder features, averaged over a 9 9 -step latent rollout on held-out data. Among these four forms, we find that RoboJEPA predictably follows the second-order power law.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是通过实证方法，找到缩放定律的具体函数形式，从而能够外推在更大规模上训练的 RoboJEPA 模型的性能预测。 我们考虑了四种候选的函数形式。 第一种是标准的幂律 L(C) = E + A C^α（Henighan 等人，2020），其指数 α 为常数。 第二种是一种推广形式，其指数本身随计算量线性变化：L(C) = E + A C^{α−γ\ln C}；我们将前者称为一阶幂律，后者称为二阶幂律。2 2 2 可以很容易地证明，对于后者，ln(L-E) 与 ln C 之间的依赖关系是 ln C 的二次函数。 最后两种是断裂神经缩放定律（Caballero 等人，2022）和统一神经缩放定律（Caballero 等人，2026）。 此处，C 是总训练计算量（单位：FLOPs），而 L(C) 是世界模型的前向预测误差，即预测结果与编码器特征之间的每词元 ℓ₁ 距离，并在保留数据上进行的 9 步潜在序列展开中取平均。 在这四种形式中，我们发现 RoboJEPA 可预测地遵循二阶幂律。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate each model trained at each compute budget by its forward-prediction L 1 L_{1} error, L ⁡ ( C ) L(C) , on held-out data. Importantly, this is the same per-token L 1 L_{1} objective the model is trained on and that the planner minimizes at deployment ( Equation 5 ). We report L ⁡ ( C ) L(C) on two embodiments, a DROID holdout dataset collected on a real robot and a simulated RoboCasa suite. Evaluation is always on scenes unseen during training, always uses two views: one side camera (left or right) and one wrist camera, and predicts nine future steps from an initial observation under the recorded action sequence, giving a ten-step sequence in total. Further evaluation details are provided in Appendix J . For each model at each training duration we compute the total training compute C C exactly, by counting the FLOPs of every operation in one training step and multiplying by the number of steps taken across all stages. We plot the prediction error for every model and training duration against its total training compute. At each compute budget, we retain the lowest error across model sizes. These best-achievable errors form the compute-optimal frontier as a function of the training compute. Finally, we fit each candidate curve to the frontier points of the smaller models (22M–2B) and select as our scaling law the one that best extrapolates to the held-out 4B and 8B models.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们通过前向预测的 L₁ L_{1} 误差 L(C)，在预留数据上评估每个计算预算下训练的模型。 重要的是，这与模型训练时以及规划器部署时最小化的每词元 L₁ L_{1} 目标相同（方程 5）。 我们在两种实现形式上报告了 L(C)：一个是在真实机器人上收集的 DROID 预留数据集，另一个是模拟的 RoboCasa 套件。 评估始终基于训练期间未见过的场景，始终使用两个视角：一个侧摄像头（左侧或右侧）和一个手腕摄像头，并从初始观察出发，根据记录的动作序列预测未来九步，从而得到总共十步的序列。 更多评估细节见附录 J。 对于每个模型在每个训练时长下的情况，我们通过计算单个训练步骤中所有操作的 FLOP 数量，再乘以所有阶段所执行步骤的总数，精确计算出总训练计算量 C。 我们将每个模型和每个训练时长的预测误差与其总训练计算量绘制成图。 在每个计算预算下，我们保留不同模型规模中误差最低的一个。 这些最佳可达误差构成了作为训练计算量函数的计算最优前沿。 最后，我们将每条候选曲线拟合到较小模型（22M–2B）的前沿点上，并选择最能外推至预留的 4B 和 8B 模型的曲线作为我们的扩展定律。

paragraphs.en: Results. Table 2 compares the four candidate curves by how well a fit on the smaller models (22M–2B) extrapolates to the held-out 4B and 8B models. The second-order power law extrapolates best, with a held-out error of 0.6 0.6 and 1.4 × 10 − 3 1.4\times 10^{-3} on DROID and RoboCasa respectively, roughly 2 2 – 3 × 3\times lower than the standard power law ( 2.0 2.0 and 3.7 × 10 − 3 3.7\times 10^{-3} ) and below both BNSL and UNSL. We therefore adopt it as our scaling law. Figure 7 plots the forward-prediction error against training compute for all models. The lower envelope across model sizes forms the compute-optimal frontier, and no model size lies on the frontier entirely. In addition, Figure 7 plots the scaling law computed on all models as the dashed line. Interestingly, the two best candidates, the second-order law and BNSL, estimate nearly the same irreducible error, ≈ 0.2 \approx 0.2 on DROID and ≈ 0.17 \approx 0.17 on RoboCasa, indicating that RoboJEPA is close to saturation on both evaluations under its current training and data budget.

paragraphs.en: Having identified an improvement trend in offline performance of world models, we hypothesize that this improvement translates to the world model’s physical understanding of the new environment in which it operates. For example, is the action conditioning accurately mapped to the correct movements of the robot in the representation space? Are the grasping and object interaction actions correctly represented by the world model in response to incoming action? We test this hypothesis via online planning with image goals. Section 3.1 introduced the predictable improvement in offline forward-prediction, and we verify that this improvement translates into a better success rate.
paragraphs.zh: 在确认了世界模型离线性能存在改进趋势后，我们假设这种改进会转化为世界模型对其运行新环境的物理理解。 例如，动作条件是否被准确地映射到表示空间中机器人的正确运动？ 面对输入的动作，世界模型是否正确表示了抓取和物体交互动作？ 我们通过带有图像目标的在线规划来检验这一假设。 第 3.1 节介绍了离线正向预测中可预测的改进，我们验证了这种改进确实能转化为更高的成功率。

sents.en: We test this hypothesis via online planning with image goals.
sents.zh: 我们通过带有图像目标的在线规划来检验这一假设。

sents.en: Section 3.1 introduced the predictable improvement in offline forward-prediction, and we verify that this improvement translates into a better success rate.
sents.zh: 第 3.1 节介绍了离线正向预测中可预测的改进，我们验证了这种改进确实能转化为更高的成功率。

paragraphs.en: To test this hypothesis, we build a set of interactive environments on top of RoboCasa 365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) , each isolating one basic capability, and test whether more training compute improves it. In this section we focus on greedy tasks, which can be solved by one-step planning where simply moving toward the goal at every step is enough. (i) 3D understanding (pose reaching): reach a target end-effector pose in as few steps as possible. (ii) Object understanding (pose reaching while holding an object): reach a target pose while holding a grasped object, so the planner must additionally search over gripper actions to avoid dropping it. Harder tasks that require non-greedy, longer-horizon planning — such as moving around an obstacle or pushing an object to a target — are studied in Section 3.3 . Full environment and reward details are in Section G.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证这一假设，我们在 RoboCasa 365（Nasiriany 等人，2026）的基础上构建了一系列交互式环境，每个环境都专注于测试一项基本能力，并检验增加训练计算量是否能提升该能力。 在本节中，我们重点关注贪心任务，这类任务可以通过单步规划解决，即每一步只需简单地朝向目标移动即可。 (i) 三维理解（姿态到达）：尽可能用较少的步骤到达目标末端执行器姿态。 (ii) 物体理解（持物姿态到达）：在抓取物体的同时到达目标姿态，因此规划器还必须额外搜索夹爪动作，以避免物体掉落。 需要非贪心、更长规划时长的更难任务——例如绕过障碍物或将物体推至目标位置——将在第 3.3 节中研究。 完整的环境和奖励细节见第 G.4 节。

sents.en: To test this hypothesis, we build a set of interactive environments on top of RoboCasa 365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) , each isolating one basic capability, and test whether more training compute improves it.

sents.en: In this section we focus on greedy tasks, which can be solved by one-step planning where simply moving toward the goal at every step is enough.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们重点关注贪心任务，这类任务可以通过单步规划解决，即每一步只需简单地朝向目标移动即可。

sents.en: (i) 3D understanding (pose reaching): reach a target end-effector pose in as few steps as possible.
sents.zh: (i) 三维理解（姿态到达）：尽可能用较少的步骤到达目标末端执行器姿态。

sents.en: (ii) Object understanding (pose reaching while holding an object): reach a target pose while holding a grasped object, so the planner must additionally search over gripper actions to avoid dropping it.
sents.zh: (ii) 物体理解（持物姿态到达）：在抓取物体的同时到达目标姿态，因此规划器还必须额外搜索夹爪动作，以避免物体掉落。

sents.en: Harder tasks that require non-greedy, longer-horizon planning — such as moving around an obstacle or pushing an object to a target — are studied in Section 3.3 .

paragraphs.en: We use the same range of RoboJEPA checkpoints as in Section 3.1 and run each of them in our RoboCasa environments with closed-loop planning ( Mayne et al., 2000 ) , where the model re-plans toward the goal image after every executed action (full protocol in Section G.4 ). Figure 10 shows the evaluation results, measured by the simulator’s normalized cumulative reward on the performed trajectory ( Section G.4 ). Just like with the offline performance, we see a clear improvement trend of the downstream performance as we scale the training compute. For both tasks, models form a clear performance frontier, with larger models surpassing smaller ones as the training compute grows. For example, the simplest end-effector 3D movement capabilities emerge after around 10 20 10^{20} FLOPs while the basic capability of moving while holding an object emerges at around 3 × 10 20 3\times 10^{20} FLOPs of training, both of which correspond to training 50 50 M– 100 100 M-parameter models on the full multi-embodiment dataset. Due to the simplicity of these tasks, performance saturates early. Therefore, for building robotic world models, we recommend first building downstream evaluations that reflect the desired capabilities, then estimating the minimal training compute required to achieve them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了与第 3.1 节相同的 RoboJEPA 检查点范围，并在我们的 RoboCasa 环境中以闭环规划方式运行每个检查点（Mayne et al., 2000），其中模型在每次执行动作后都会重新规划以朝向目标图像（完整流程见第 G.4 节）。 图 10 展示了评估结果，该结果通过模拟器在已执行轨迹上的归一化累积奖励进行衡量（第 G.4 节）。 与离线表现一样，随着训练计算量的增加，我们观察到下游任务表现呈现出明显的提升趋势。 在这两个任务中，模型形成了清晰的表现边界：随着训练计算量的增长，较大规模的模型会超越较小规模的模型。 例如，最简单的末端执行器三维移动能力在约 10^{20} FLOPs 后出现，而边持物边移动的基本能力则在约 3 × 10^{20} FLOPs 的训练后出现，这两种能力都对应于在完整的多具身数据集上训练拥有 5000 万至 1 亿个参数的模型。 由于这些任务的简单性，模型表现会较早达到饱和。 因此，在构建机器人世界模型时，我们建议首先建立能够反映预期能力的下游评估指标，然后估算实现这些能力所需的最小训练计算量。

paragraphs.en: With the established transfer from offline performance to online greedy performance in Sections 3.1 and 3.2 , we now ask whether the same offline-to-online connection holds for non-greedy , longer-horizon tasks that cannot be solved in one step. We design two such tasks in RoboCasa. The first is an obstacle-reach task: the goal is again to reach a target end-effector position, but we place a large object (a kitchen appliance) as an obstacle so that a direct straight-line motion cannot reach the goal. The second is an object-push task, where an object is placed on the table in front of the robot and the goal is to move it toward a target position, which requires the arm to descend to the object, push it, and ascend back. Full task definitions are in Section G.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 在第 3.1 节和第 3.2 节中，我们已经建立了从离线性能到在线贪心性能的转换关系。现在，我们想探究这种从离线到在线的关联是否同样适用于非贪心、更长时长的任务——这些任务无法通过单一步骤完成。 我们在 RoboCasa 中设计了两个这样的任务。 第一个任务是障碍物抓取任务：目标仍然是使末端执行器到达指定位置，但我们放置了一个大型物体（厨房电器）作为障碍物，使得直接沿直线运动无法到达目标。 第二个任务是物体推动任务：一个物体被放置在机器人前方的桌子上，目标是将它移动到指定位置。这要求机械臂先下降到物体旁，将其推动，然后上升返回。 完整的任务定义见 G.4 节。

paragraphs.en: frontier emerges: smaller models often beat larger ones (for example, the 300 300 M planner reaches a higher final reward than the 1 1 B one). Unlike the greedy tasks of Section 3.2 , predictable scaling does not emerge for longer-horizon tasks, which we attribute to a mismatch between training and deployment. Planning on these tasks relies on accurate long-horizon prediction, yet the models were trained with only a short autoregressive rollout ( K = 2 K=2 steps). We therefore align training with how the model is used at test time and increase the training rollout to K = 10 K=10 steps during the cooldown, together with higher-resolution inputs. We refer to the two cooldown recipes as short-horizon prediction training ( K = 2 K=2 , 240 × 320 240\times 320 ) and long-horizon prediction training ( K = 10 K=10 , a mix of 240 × 320 240\times 320 and 480 × 640 480\times 640 ). Retraining every model from scratch this way would be prohibitively computationally expensive, so we run the long-horizon cooldown only from the flat-learning-rate pretraining checkpoints ( Section 2.2 ): the long flat-learning-rate stage only needs to learn the coarse dynamics cheaply, and the computationally expensive long-rollout, high-resolution signal is spent where it matters, in the final annealing phase.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿现象显现：较小的模型通常能击败较大的模型（例如，300M 规划器的最终奖励高于 1B 规划器）。 与第 3.2 节中的贪心任务不同，在更长时域的任务中并未出现可预测的扩展规律，我们认为这是训练与部署之间的不匹配所致。 在这些任务上进行规划依赖于对长时域的准确预测，但这些模型仅通过较短的自回归展开（K = 2 步）进行训练。 因此，我们将训练方式与模型在测试时的使用方式保持一致，并在冷却阶段将训练展开步数增加到 K = 10 步，同时采用更高分辨率的输入。 我们将两种冷却方案称为短时域预测训练（K = 2，240 × 320）和长时域预测训练（K = 10，混合使用 240 × 320 和 480 × 640）。 以这种方式从头重新训练每个模型将产生极高的计算成本，因此我们仅从固定学习率预训练的检查点（第 2.2 节）开始执行长时域冷却：长固定学习率阶段只需低成本地学习粗略的动力学特性，而计算成本高昂的长展开和高分辨率信号则被用于真正关键的最终退火阶段。

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 compares the two recipes by their scaling laws on DROID and RoboCasa. Long-horizon prediction training is more computationally expensive per step, but it becomes more compute-efficient beyond about 10 21 10^{21} FLOPs of total training compute (around 300 300 M– 1 1 B parameters at the compute-optimal frontier) and reaches a substantially lower forward-prediction error. It also lowers the irreducible error of the fit, indicating a genuine reduction in error accumulation.
paragraphs.zh: 图 14 通过 DROID 和 RoboCasa 上的缩放定律比较了这两种方法。 长期预测训练在每一步的计算成本更高，但在总训练计算量超过约 10^{21} FLOPs（在计算最优前沿上约为 300 M–1 B 参数）之后，其计算效率会显著提升，并且前向预测误差也会大幅降低。 它还能降低拟合的不可约误差，表明误差累积确实得到了有效减少。

paragraphs.en: Deploying the non-greedy planning models on the obstacle-reach task ( Figure 14 ) significantly improves the trend: the final reward now strongly follows the predictable scaling pattern. Small models (below 300 300 M parameters) cap at around 0.3 0.3 , which corresponds to the end-effector remaining stuck on the wrong side of the obstacle. The obstacle-avoidance capability then takes off around 10 21 10^{21} FLOPs and saturates around 10 22 10^{22} FLOPs. This is much later than the end-effector capabilities of Section 3.2 , which emerged around 10 20 10^{20} – 3 × 10 20 3\times 10^{20} FLOPs, indicating that modeling interaction with the static scene geometry requires considerably more training.
paragraphs.zh: 在障碍物可达性任务（图 14）中部署非贪婪规划模型显著改善了趋势：最终奖励现在严格遵循可预测的缩放模式。 小型模型（参数低于 300 M）的性能上限约为 0.3，这对应于末端执行器仍卡在障碍物的错误一侧。 随后，在约 10^{21} FLOPs 时，障碍物规避能力开始显著提升，并在约 10^{22} FLOPs 时趋于饱和。 这一阶段远晚于第 3.2 节中末端执行器能力的出现时间（约 10^{20} – 3×10^{20} FLOPs），表明对静态场景几何结构的交互建模需要更多训练。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the object-push task assesses the object interaction understanding (through non-greedy planning) by the world model: because the robot’s start and goal poses are identical (so the side and wrist views change only through the object’s position), the model must understand that pushing the object is what changes the scene. Figure 15 shows the success rate, defined simply as whether the object moved toward its target position ( Section G.4 ). Interestingly, no model achieves a positive success rate until around 10 22 10^{22} FLOPs, after which all models begin to succeed, suggesting that fine-grained understanding of surrounding objects emerges after certain training computation regardless of the model size. In summary, these results align in a natural order in which capabilities appear with more compute: first the 3D control of the end-effector, then manipulating a grasped object, then the geometry of the static scene, and finally the dynamics of objects in the scene.

paragraphs.en: Our ultimate goal is to showcase the capabilities of RoboJEPA in real-world settings. As a step towards this goal, we deploy RoboJEPA models ranging from 22M to 8B parameters on the DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) platform with a single-arm Franka robot and two cameras: an external camera mounted to the left of the arm and a wrist camera using the standard DROID mount. To deploy RoboJEPA via planning, we record an image goal on the robot by executing a predefined robot motion and manually placing the object in the grasping position so the robot can interact with it. We provide only a single final image goal, requiring longer-horizon, non-greedy planning. We evaluate three tasks: Grasp, Object Lift, and Pick and Place. We use the same planning hyperparameters across tasks and model sizes, evaluating the highest-compute checkpoint at each size. Setup, task definitions, episode counts, scoring criteria, and planning hyperparameters are detailed in Sections G.1 to G.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的最终目标是在真实世界环境中展示 RoboJEPA 的能力。 为实现这一目标，我们在 DROID（Khazatsky 等人，2024）平台上部署了参数规模从 22M 到 8B 不等的 RoboJEPA 模型，并使用单臂 Franka 机器人和两台摄像头：一台安装在机械臂左侧的外部摄像头，以及一台使用标准 DROID 支架的手腕摄像头。 为了通过规划部署 RoboJEPA，我们通过执行预定义的机器人动作并在抓取位置手动放置物体，在机器人上记录一个图像目标，以便机器人能够与之互动。 我们仅提供一个最终的图像目标，因此需要更长时间跨度、非贪心的规划。 我们评估了三项任务：抓取、物体提升以及抓取与放置。 我们在所有任务和模型规模中均使用相同的规划超参数，并在每个规模下评估计算量最高的检查点。 设置、任务定义、回合数量、评分标准和规划超参数详见第 G.1 至 G.3 节。

paragraphs.en: To contextualize the RoboJEPA results, we also evaluate the Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models π 0 \pi_{0} -FAST ( Pertsch et al., 2025 ) and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025 ) . However, their deployment differs in goal specification (text instructions versus a single goal image) and training (DROID fine-tuning for the VLA baselines versus pretraining on a mixture that includes DROID for RoboJEPA). Neither RoboJEPA nor the VLA baselines receive task-specific fine-tuning. These differences make the VLA results contextual references rather than directly comparable baselines. Figure 16 shows the scaling trend. For each task, all RoboJEPA models, including very small models, demonstrate non-zero success rates. Overall, success rates show a clear trend of improving with model size and generally decreasing with task complexity. This picture does not hold for the reference models, which work best on Pick and Place, the hardest task, but degrade significantly on the others. For example, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} achieves a 53 % 53\% success rate on Pick and Place but 0 % 0\% on Object Lift. We hypothesize that this difference may be an artifact of training, as verbs such as “lift” are heavily underrepresented in the DROID dataset, which focuses mostly on pick-and-place tasks. Due to the planning nature of the agent and the task specification as an image goal, RoboJEPA models are not susceptible to this type of degradation. Qualitatively, behavior transitioned gradually from smooth but less adaptive execution in smaller models to more reliable recovery from mistakes in larger models ( Section G.7 ). Table 3 reports task progress and success rates for the largest RoboJEPA models and VLA references.

paragraphs.en: So far we have quantified the world model through its prediction loss and downstream planning success; we now inspect how the prediction improves qualitatively by decoding its latent rollouts back to pixels. To do that, we use the diffusion decoder introduced in Section 2.3 . The decoder serves purely as a visualization tool and is trained only on the frozen V-JEPA 2.1-G encoder features (see Appendix D ). Note that all visualizations use the same encoder and decoder and vary only the RoboJEPA world model size. We perform forward prediction given a single frame (or a pair of frames) and a sequence of robot actions, and each sequence of predicted embeddings is decoded back to pixels. We run the prediction across a range of settings — low- and high-resolution, single- and dual-view — and report them separately ( Figures 2 and 4 ; full set in Appendix E ); the decoder itself is trained at a single 240 × 320 240{\times}320 resolution. These visualizations show that the forward-prediction improves with model scale in several concrete ways: larger models track the true dynamics more accurately over the rollout, preserve object identity and fine manipulation detail, and keep multiple camera views mutually consistent. Several behaviors are effectively emergent with scale — gripper–object contact and structured deformation such as folding appear only once the predictor is large enough, whereas smaller models blur these interactions away. Finally, we finetune the 8 8 B version of RoboJEPA on DROID to imagine all three camera views simultaneously at high ( 720 720 p) resolution ( Section C.4 ; Figure 17 ). These rollouts demonstrate that RoboJEPA performs accurate object manipulation even at very high resolution, and they exhibit strong cross-view information transfer, with content from the side (exterior) cameras propagating into the wrist-camera imagination.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，我们通过预测损失和下游规划的成功率对世界模型进行了量化；现在，我们将通过将其潜在展开序列解码回像素，来定性检验预测质量的提升。 为此，我们使用了第 2.3 节中介绍的扩散解码器。 该解码器纯粹作为可视化工具使用，并且仅基于冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1-G 编码器特征进行训练（参见附录 D）。 请注意，所有可视化均使用相同的编码器和解码器，唯一变化的因素是 RoboJEPA 世界模型的大小。 我们基于单帧（或一对帧）和一系列机器人动作执行前向预测，并将每个预测嵌入序列解码回像素。 我们在多种设置下运行预测——包括低分辨率与高分辨率、单视角与双视角——并分别报告结果（图 2 和图 4；完整集合见附录 E）；解码器本身则以单一的 240 × 320 分辨率进行训练。 这些可视化表明，随着模型规模的增大，前向预测在多个具体方面得到改善：更大规模的模型能在展开序列中更准确地追踪真实动态，保留物体身份和精细操控细节，并维持多摄像头视角之间的一致性。 某些行为实际上随模型规模增大而涌现——例如夹具与物体的接触以及折叠等结构化形变，仅在预测器足够大时才会出现，而较小规模的模型则会模糊这些交互。 最后，我们在 DROID 数据集上对 RoboJEPA 的 8B 版本进行微调，以在高分辨率（720p）下同时生成所有三个摄像头视角的图像（第 C.4 节；图 17）。 这些展开序列表明，RoboJEPA 即使在极高分辨率下也能准确执行物体操控，并展现出强大的跨视角信息传递能力：来自侧面（外部）摄像头的信息会传播到腕部摄像头的生成结果中。

paragraphs.en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) were proposed as a path towards self-supervised models that learn abstract representations of the world by predicting in a latent space rather than at the pixel level ( LeCun, 2022 ) . I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) instantiated this recipe for images by predicting the representations of masked image regions from visible context, avoiding pixel-level reconstruction and the resulting collapse to low-level texture. V-JEPA extended the framework to video by predicting masked spatio-temporal feature regions and showed that the resulting features capture motion and temporal structure ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) . Assran et al. (2025) scaled feature prediction to over a million hours of internet video and, crucially for our setting, post-trained an action-conditioned predictor (V-JEPA 2-AC) on a small amount of unlabeled robot interaction data, enabling zero-shot Franka manipulation by latent planning against image goals. Our work, RoboJEPA , is similar to V-JEPA 2-AC in terms of the approach. We keep the V-JEPA encoder frozen and focus on the action-conditioned predictor as a world model . However, compared to V-JEPA 2 AC, we replace the small post-training corpus with a unified, large-scale mixture of robot demonstrations, therefore, the methods are not apples-to-apples comparable. To our knowledge, we provide the first systematic recipe for scaling V-JEPA-style action-conditioned predictors on large-scale, multi-embodiment robot data, and we characterize how predictor performance scales with parameters and demonstration tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 联合嵌入预测架构。 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）被提出作为一种实现自监督模型的路径，这些模型通过在潜在空间而非像素级别进行预测来学习对世界的抽象表示（LeCun, 2022）。 I-JEPA（Assran et al., 2023）将这一方法应用于图像，通过利用可见上下文预测被掩码图像区域的表示，从而避免了像素级别的重建及其导致的低层次纹理退化问题。 V-JEPA 将这一框架扩展到视频领域，通过预测被掩码的时空特征区域，并证明了由此得到的特征能够捕捉运动和时序结构（Bardes et al., 2024）。Assran et al. （2025）将特征预测扩展到了超过一百万小时的互联网视频，并且——这对我们的研究至关重要——在少量未标注的机器人交互数据上对动作条件预测器（V-JEPA 2-AC）进行了后训练，从而使得通过潜在规划针对图像目标实现零样本 Franka 操控成为可能。 我们的工作 RoboJEPA 在方法上与 V-JEPA 2-AC 类似。 我们保持 V-JEPA 编码器冻结，并专注于将动作条件预测器作为世界模型使用。 然而，与 V-JEPA 2 AC 相比，我们将较小的后训练语料库替换为包含机器人演示的统一大规模混合数据，因此这两种方法无法直接进行同类比较。 据我们所知，我们首次提出了在大规模、多具身机器人数据上扩展 V-JEPA 风格动作条件预测器的系统性方法，并描述了预测器性能如何随参数和演示标记数量的变化而扩展。

sents.en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures.
sents.zh: 联合嵌入预测架构。

sents.en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) were proposed as a path towards self-supervised models that learn abstract representations of the world by predicting in a latent space rather than at the pixel level ( LeCun, 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）被提出作为一种实现自监督模型的路径，这些模型通过在潜在空间而非像素级别进行预测来学习对世界的抽象表示（LeCun, 2022）。

sents.en: I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) instantiated this recipe for images by predicting the representations of masked image regions from visible context, avoiding pixel-level reconstruction and the resulting collapse to low-level texture.
sents.zh: I-JEPA（Assran et al., 2023）将这一方法应用于图像，通过利用可见上下文预测被掩码图像区域的表示，从而避免了像素级别的重建及其导致的低层次纹理退化问题。

sents.en: V-JEPA extended the framework to video by predicting masked spatio-temporal feature regions and showed that the resulting features capture motion and temporal structure ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) . Assran et al.
sents.zh: V-JEPA 将这一框架扩展到视频领域，通过预测被掩码的时空特征区域，并证明了由此得到的特征能够捕捉运动和时序结构（Bardes et al., 2024）。Assran et al.

sents.en: Our work, RoboJEPA , is similar to V-JEPA 2-AC in terms of the approach.
sents.zh: 我们的工作 RoboJEPA 在方法上与 V-JEPA 2-AC 类似。

sents.en: We keep the V-JEPA encoder frozen and focus on the action-conditioned predictor as a world model .
sents.zh: 我们保持 V-JEPA 编码器冻结，并专注于将动作条件预测器作为世界模型使用。

sents.zh: 然而，与 V-JEPA 2 AC 相比，我们将较小的后训练语料库替换为包含机器人演示的统一大规模混合数据，因此这两种方法无法直接进行同类比较。

paragraphs.en: World Models for Robotics. World models compress experience into a learned simulator of the environment that an agent can train and plan in ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) . The Dreamer family pioneered this paradigm at scale: PlaNet learned latent dynamics for planning from pixels ( Hafner et al., 2019 ) , Dreamer used latent imagination to learn behaviors ( Hafner et al., 2020 ) , DreamerV2 introduced discrete latents to master Atari ( Hafner et al., 2021 ) , and DreamerV3 demonstrated a single set of hyperparameters that succeeds across a wide range of domains including 3D control ( Hafner et al., 2023 ) . DayDreamer applied Dreamer directly to physical robots and learned locomotion and manipulation in the real world ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , while Masked World Models showed that decoupling visual representation learning from dynamics modeling improves sample efficiency ( Seo et al., 2023 ) . More recent work has scaled video-based world models with transformer and diffusion backbones: IRIS ( Micheli et al., 2023 ) and iVideoGPT ( Wu et al., 2024a ) treat world modeling as autoregressive token prediction; UniSim ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) , and GAIA-1 ( Hu et al., 2023 ) train large generative simulators of interactive scenes; and the Cosmos platform releases physical-AI world foundation models at industrial scale ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) . In contrast to these pixel-space generators, RoboJEPA predicts in the representation space of a frozen V-JEPA encoder, which is what allows us to scale the predictor to billions of parameters on robot data without paying the computational cost of pixel-level reconstruction at every step.
paragraphs.zh: 用于机器人技术的世界模型。 世界模型将经验压缩为环境的已学习模拟器，智能体可以在其中进行训练和规划（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018）。 Dreamer 系列在这一范式的大规模应用中发挥了开创性作用：PlaNet 从像素中学习潜在动态以用于规划（Hafner 等，2019），Dreamer 利用潜在想象力学习行为（Hafner 等，2020），DreamerV2 引入离散潜在变量以掌握 Atari 游戏（Hafner 等，2021），而 DreamerV3 则展示了一套可在包括三维控制在内的广泛领域取得成功的一组超参数（Hafner 等，2023）。 DayDreamer 将 Dreamer 直接应用于物理机器人，并在真实世界中学习了移动和操控能力（Wu 等，2023），而掩码世界模型则表明，将视觉表示学习与动态建模解耦可以提高样本效率（Seo 等，2023）。 近期的研究利用 Transformer 和扩散模型作为主干，扩展了基于视频的世界模型：IRIS（Micheli 等，2023）和 iVideoGPT（Wu 等，2024a）将世界建模视为自回归的标记预测；UniSim（Yang 等，2024）、Genie（Bruce 等，2024）和 GAIA-1（Hu 等，2023）训练了大型交互式场景的生成式模拟器；而 Cosmos 平台则以工业规模发布了物理-人工智能世界基础模型（NVIDIA，2025）。 与这些像素空间生成器不同，RoboJEPA 在冻结的 V-JEPA 编码器的表示空间中进行预测，这使得我们能够在机器人数据上将预测模型的参数规模扩展到数十亿，而无需在每一步都承担像素级重建的计算成本。

paragraphs.en: Planning with Learned World Models. A central use of a world model is test-time planning. Classical model-based control methods such as PETS ( Chua et al., 2018 ) , model-based RL with neural network dynamics ( Nagabandi et al., 2018 ) , and visual foresight ( Finn and Levine, 2017 ) optimize action sequences against a learned dynamics model. Sampling-based shooting methods, in particular the Cross-Entropy Method ( Rubinstein, 1997 ; de Boer et al., 2005 ) and Model Predictive Path Integral control ( Williams et al., 2017 ) , remain the workhorses for high-dimensional action search. TD-MPC and TD-MPC2 combine latent dynamics, value learning, and CEM-style trajectory optimization for robust continuous control ( Hansen et al., 2022 ; Hansen et al., 2024 ) . DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) learns task-agnostic dynamics in DINOv2 feature space from offline trajectories using an approximately 20 20 M-parameter predictor, and uses CEM to plan toward image goals without additional task-specific training. RoboJEPA follows this line: at deployment, we use CEM in the latent space of the world model to score action sequences by how close their predicted features land to a goal image’s features, and execute the first action of the best plan in receding-horizon fashion.
paragraphs.zh: 基于学习世界模型的规划。 世界模型的核心用途之一是测试时的规划。 经典的基于模型的控制方法，例如 PETS（Chua 等人，2018）、结合神经网络动态的基于模型强化学习（Nagabandi 等人，2018）以及视觉预见性（Finn 和 Levine，2017），都会根据所学到的动态模型对动作序列进行优化。 基于采样的射击方法，特别是交叉熵法（Rubinstein，1997；de Boer 等人，2005）和模型预测路径积分控制（Williams 等人，2017），仍然是高维动作搜索的主要方法。 TD-MPC 和 TD-MPC2 将潜在动态、价值学习和 CEM 风格的轨迹优化相结合，以实现稳健的连续控制（Hansen 等人，2022；Hansen 等人，2024）。 DINO-WM（Zhou 等人，2025）利用一个约含 2020 个百万参数的预测器，从离线轨迹中学习 DINOv2 特征空间中与任务无关的动态，并使用 CEM 规划图像目标，而无需额外的任务特定训练。 RoboJEPA 遵循这一思路：在部署时，我们在世界模型的潜在空间中使用 CEM，通过预测特征与目标图像特征的接近程度来评估动作序列，并以滚动视域的方式执行最佳规划中的第一个动作。

paragraphs.en: Closely related to our work, Terver et al. (2026) investigate how architectural, training, and planning choices affect latent world-model performance, including model and data scaling, albeit at smaller scales. Their proposed DROID predictor has approximately 229 229 M parameters and is trained on an 8,000 8{,}000 -trajectory dataset. We extend this investigation both by scaling to substantially larger world models (up to 8 8 B parameters) and datasets (a mixture of approximately 2.87 2.87 M trajectories across 12 12 robot platforms) and by explicitly studying their scaling behavior through scaling laws.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们的工作密切相关的是 Terver 等人 (2026) 研究了架构、训练和规划方面的选择如何影响潜在世界模型的性能，包括模型和数据规模的扩展，尽管其研究规模较小。 他们提出的 DROID 预测器约有 229,229 M 个参数，并在一个包含 8,000 条轨迹的数据集上进行训练。 我们通过将世界模型（最多达 8 B 个参数）和数据集（由 12 个机器人平台上的约 2.87 M 条轨迹混合而成）扩展至更大规模，并明确通过缩放定律研究其缩放行为，从而拓展了这一研究。

paragraphs.en: Robotic Foundation Models from Demonstrations. A complementary line of work scales policies directly on robot demonstrations rather than scaling world models. RT-1 ( Brohan et al., 2023 ) and RT-2 ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ) train large transformer- and vision-language-action policies on broad manipulation data. Open X-Embodiment Collaboration et al. (2023) aggregate demonstrations across many embodiments to enable cross-embodiment generalist policies, and a wave of recent generalist models such as Octo ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ) , OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , and π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2024 ) push this behavior-cloning recipe further. RoboJEPA shares the same data substrate (in particular Open X-Embodiment, DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) , RoboMIND ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , BridgeData V2 ( Walke et al., 2023 ) , LeRobot ( Cadene et al., 2024 ) , and AgiBot World ( AgiBot-World-Contributors et al., 2025 ) ), but trains a goal-agnostic, action-conditioned predictive model instead of a task-conditioned policy. The same world model can then be used to evaluate or improve any policy, and to plan zero-shot for new goals at test time.
paragraphs.zh: 基于演示的机器人基础模型。 另一条互补的研究路线则直接在机器人演示数据上扩展策略，而非扩展世界模型。 RT-1（Brohan 等，2023）和 RT-2（Zitkovich 等，2023）在广泛的操控数据上训练了大型 Transformer 和视觉-语言-动作策略。 Open X-Embodiment Collaboration 等。 （2023）通过整合多种具身形态的演示数据，实现了跨具身形态的通用策略；近期涌现的一系列通用模型，如 Octo（Ghosh 等，2024）、OpenVLA（Kim 等，2024）和 π₀（Black 等，2024），进一步推动了这种行为克隆方法的发展。 RoboJEPA 共享相同的数据基础（特别是 Open X-Embodiment、DROID（Khazatsky 等，2024）、RoboMIND（Wu 等，2024b）、BridgeData V2（Walke 等，2023）、LeRobot（Cadene 等，2024）和 AgiBot World（AgiBot-World-Contributors 等，2025）），但它训练的是一个与目标无关、以动作为条件的预测模型，而非以任务为条件的策略。 随后，同一个世界模型可用于评估或改进任何策略，并能在测试阶段对新的目标进行零样本规划。

sents.zh: RoboJEPA 共享相同的数据基础（特别是 Open X-Embodiment、DROID（Khazatsky 等，2024）、RoboMIND（Wu 等，2024b）、BridgeData V2（Walke 等，2023）、LeRobot（Cadene 等，2024）和 AgiBot World（AgiBot-World-Contributors 等，2025）），但它训练的是一个与目标无关、以动作为条件的预测模型，而非以任务为条件的策略。

sents.en: The same world model can then be used to evaluate or improve any policy, and to plan zero-shot for new goals at test time.
sents.zh: 随后，同一个世界模型可用于评估或改进任何策略，并能在测试阶段对新的目标进行零样本规划。

paragraphs.en: Scaling Laws. Power-law scaling of model loss with parameters, data, and compute has been documented extensively for language models ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) , generative modeling more broadly ( Henighan et al., 2020 ) , and vision transformers ( Zhai et al., 2022 ) , with compute-optimal allocations of model and data established by Chinchilla ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) . In robotics, however, scaling laws are largely an open question because high-quality interaction data is scarce. We provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic scaling study for action-conditioned world models trained on large-scale, multi-embodiment real robot demonstrations, characterizing how forward-prediction loss scales with predictor parameters and demonstration tokens, and showing that this scaling behavior transfers to downstream planning performance.
paragraphs.zh: 缩放定律。 模型损失随参数、数据和计算量的幂律缩放关系已在语言模型（Kaplan 等人，2020）、更广泛的生成建模领域（Henighan 等人，2020）以及视觉变换器（Zhai 等人，2022）中得到广泛记录，而 Chinchilla（Hoffmann 等人，2022）则确立了模型与数据在计算效率上的最优分配方案。 然而，在机器人领域，缩放定律在很大程度上仍是一个未解问题，因为高质量交互数据的稀缺性。 据我们所知，我们首次对基于大规模多具身真实机器人演示训练的动作条件世界模型进行了系统性缩放研究，描述了前向预测损失如何随预测器参数和演示标记进行缩放，并证明了这种缩放行为能够迁移到下游的规划性能中。

paragraphs.en: Scaling world models. A growing body of work reports that world models improve with scale. In autonomous driving, the GAIA line of latent-diffusion world models has been scaled to billions of parameters for controllable simulation and offline evaluation ( Russell et al., 2025 ; Wayve, 2025 ; Wayve, 2026 ) , though technical details beyond GAIA-2 are not publicly available. Pearce et al. (2024) fit power laws for pre-trained agents and world models and, in their appendix, report scaling laws for a robotic world model, but their study is otherwise centered on game and simulated environments rather than large-scale real-world multi-embodiment robot data. Sato et al. (2023) study how world-model quality varies with model size; IRASim ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) reports empirical scaling trends for a fine-grained video world model for manipulation; PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) shows that a 3D point-flow world model improves with more data and parameters; and DINO-world ( Baldassarre et al., 2025 ) scales video prediction in the feature space of a frozen DINOv2 encoder using predictors with up to 1.1 1.1 B parameters. Closest in spirit, τ 0 \tau_{0} -VLA ( Cai et al., 2026 ) scales test-time computation of a hierarchical policy using a world model to score candidate subtasks, and Dyna-2 ( Dyna Robotics, 2026 ) scales a world-action model over a million hours of human and robot video and measures action -prediction quality. RoboJEPA differs from these along two axes: we scale training compute of a pure world model and measure its future-embedding (imagination) accuracy, and we fit an explicit scaling law rather than an empirical trend. This is a very important distinction, as an empirical scaling trend only establishes that a metric improves as one adds parameters, data, or compute, but says nothing about how much it will improve, whether returns have begun to saturate, or whether the next unit of budget is better spent on model size or on data. A scaling law, by contrast, is predictive : it extrapolates performance well beyond the scale at which it was fit, turning these decisions into quantitative forecasts. Establishing such predictive laws for action-conditioned robotic world models—and connecting them to downstream planning—is, to our knowledge, what sets this work apart.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型的扩展。越来越多的研究指出，世界模型的性能会随着规模的扩大而提升。在自动驾驶领域，GAIA系列的潜在扩散世界模型已被扩展至数十亿参数规模，以实现可控的模拟和离线评估（Russell 等，2025；Wayve，2025；Wayve，2026），尽管 GAIA-2 之后的技术细节尚未公开。Pearce 等（2024）为预训练的智能体和世界模型拟合了幂律关系，并在其附录中报告了一个机器人世界模型的扩展定律，但他们的研究主要聚焦于游戏和模拟环境，而非大规模的真实世界多具身机器人数据。Sato 等（2023）研究了世界模型质量如何随模型规模变化；IRASim（Zhu 等，2025）报告了一种用于操作任务的精细视频世界模型的实证扩展趋势；PointWorld（Huang 等，2026）表明，一种三维点流世界模型会随着更多数据和参数的加入而性能提升；DINO-world（Baldassarre 等，2025）则通过最多达 1.1B 参数的预测器，在冻结的 DINOv2 编码器的特征空间中扩展了视频预测能力。在研究理念上最接近我们工作的是 τ₀-VLA（Cai 等，2026），它利用世界模型对候选子任务进行评分，从而扩展了分层策略在测试时的计算规模；以及 Dyna-2（Dyna Robotics，2026），它在超过一百万小时的人类和机器人视频数据上扩展了世界-动作模型，并测量了动作预测的质量。RoboJEPA 与这些工作存在两个关键差异：我们扩展的是纯世界模型的训练计算资源，并测量其未来嵌入（即想象能力）的准确性；同时，我们拟合了一个明确的扩展定律，而非仅仅描述一种经验趋势。这是一个非常重要的区别，因为经验性扩展趋势只能说明某个指标会随着参数、数据或计算资源的增加而改善，但无法说明改善的具体程度、收益是否已开始饱和，或者下一单位资源是投入模型规模还是数据更划算。相比之下，扩展定律具有预测性：它能够将性能外推至远超其拟合时的规模范围，从而将这些决策转化为定量预测。据我们所知，为基于动作的机器人世界模型建立此类预测性定律，并将其与下游规划任务联系起来，正是本研究的核心创新所在。

paragraphs.en: We introduced RoboJEPA , a family of action-conditioned latent world models trained on a large-scale, multi-embodiment robotic data collection in the latent space of V-JEPA 2.1. RoboJEPA predicts the next embedding in a single forward pass, and we train it to predict the future conditioned on past embeddings and future actions. We presented a recipe for scaling the predictor that works from 22M to 8B parameters, the latter being the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date. We then established scaling laws that predict the world-modeling error as we scale training compute. These take the form of a second-order power law L ⁡ ( C ) = E + A ​ C α − γ ​ ln ⁡ C L(C)=E+A\,C^{\alpha-\gamma\ln C} . We established these laws for both a real-world (DROID) and a simulated (RoboCasa) embodiment. Finally, we demonstrated that offline prediction scaling laws correlate with the online downstream performance of world models, evaluated via planning toward a single image goal, which makes the offline imagination error a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation and spares much of its computational cost. We also found that distinct manipulation capabilities emerge at their own compute thresholds, in a natural order from end-effector control, to manipulating a grasped object, to reasoning about static scene geometry, and finally to the dynamics of objects in the scene. On a real robot, we showed that the policy induced by world-model planning improves in success rate and in qualitative behavior as the world model scales. We also built a diffusion decoder to visualize the predicted action-conditioned future in pixel space, and used it to show that qualitatively better robotic predictions emerge with scale. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot-deployment code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RoboJEPA——一系列以动作条件化的潜在世界模型，这些模型基于大规模、多具身的机器人数据收集，在 V-JEPA 2.1 的潜在空间中训练。 RoboJEPA 通过单次前向传播预测下一个嵌入向量，并且我们通过训练使其能够根据过去的嵌入向量和未来的动作来预测未来。 我们提出了一种扩展预测器的方案，该方案可将参数规模从 2200 万提升至 80 亿，后者是目前为止训练过的最大 JEPA 预测器模型。 接着，我们建立了扩展定律，用于预测随着训练计算资源扩展时世界建模误差的变化。 这些定律表现为一个二阶幂律：L(C) = E + A·C^{α−γ ln C}。 我们为真实世界（DROID）和模拟环境（RoboCasa）中的具身系统分别建立了这些定律。 最后，我们证明了离线预测的扩展定律与世界模型的在线下游性能相关；后者通过规划实现单一图像目标进行评估，这使得离线想象误差成为评估真实机器人性能的可靠代理，并大幅节省了计算成本。 我们还发现，不同的操控能力会在各自的计算阈值上依次出现：从末端执行器控制，到操控已抓取的对象，再到推理静态场景的几何结构，最后是场景中物体的动力学行为。 在真实机器人上，我们展示了由世界模型规划生成的策略，其成功率和定性表现会随着世界模型的扩展而提升。 我们还构建了一个扩散解码器，用于将预测的动作条件化未来在像素空间中可视化，并利用它证明了随着模型规模的扩大，机器人的预测质量也会显著提升。 我们公开了所有模型检查点，以及训练和机器人部署代码。

paragraphs.en: Our study also has limitations that mark natural next steps. We scaled the predictor while keeping the V-JEPA 2.1 encoder frozen, so our laws describe a dynamics model on top of a fixed representation rather than the encoder and predictor jointly. Because we train for multiple epochs over a fixed corpus, our fits already sit close to data saturation, so pushing the frontier further will likely require more and more diverse interaction data rather than parameters alone. RoboJEPA also makes no use of text, planning instead toward a single image goal, and it makes no use of a learned policy proposal during planning, sampling actions from a uniform distribution and prioritizing them with the world model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究也存在一些局限性，这些局限性指明了自然的后续研究方向。 我们在保持 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器冻结的同时扩展了预测器，因此我们的定律描述的是在固定表示之上的动态模型，而非编码器和预测器的联合模型。 由于我们在固定语料库上进行了多个训练周期，我们的拟合结果已经接近数据饱和状态，因此要进一步突破这一界限，可能需要更多样化的交互数据，而不仅仅是增加参数。 RoboJEPA 也没有使用文本，而是专注于单一图像目标进行规划；在规划过程中，它也不会利用已学习的策略提案，而是从均匀分布中采样动作，并通过世界模型对这些动作进行优先级排序。

Pairs in different axis sub-blocks rotate independently and at independent frequencies, so the inner product ⟨ q ′ , k ′ ⟩ \langle q^{\prime},k^{\prime}\rangle telescopes into a sum of per-axis, per-pair terms whose differences depend only on relative positions Δ ​ pos α = pos α − pos α ′ \Delta\!\mathrm{pos}_{\alpha}=\mathrm{pos}_{\alpha}-\mathrm{pos}^{\prime}_{\alpha} . This relative-position property lets the predictor generalize across V ∈ { 1 , 2 } V\!\in\!\{1,2\} views and across the training and deployment patch grids of Section 2.2 without re-learning positional codes.
paragraphs.zh: 对于关键通道也是如此。 不同轴子块中的成对项独立旋转，且以独立的频率旋转，因此内积 ⟨ q ′ , k ′ ⟩ \langle q^{\prime},k^{\prime}\rangle 可展开为各轴、各成对项之和，其差异仅取决于相对位置 Δ ​ pos α = pos α − pos α ′ \Delta\!\mathrm{pos}_{\alpha}=\mathrm{pos}_{\alpha}-\mathrm{pos}^{\prime}_{\alpha}。 这种相对位置特性使得预测器能够在 V ∈ { 1 , 2 } V\!\in\!\{1,2\} 个视图以及第 2.2 节中训练和部署的图块网格之间实现泛化，而无需重新学习位置编码。

paragraphs.en: Under multi-view training ( V max = 2 V_{\max}{=}2 ) we use the full 4-axis partition 𝒜 = { t , i , j , v } \mathcal{A}\!=\!\{t,i,j,v\} : the v v -axis sub-block contributes its own rotation, and viewpoint identity is additionally supplied by the per-block additive bias of Section A.2 (the two are complementary). For purely single-view runs ( V = 1 V{=}1 ) the v v -axis sub-block carries no rotation and is left as the identity. Action and state tokens are detached from the visual slab before the RoPE rotation is applied: only the time component of RoPE rotates them (indexed by their step id), so that a single proprioceptive token per step does not spuriously inherit a spatial position.
paragraphs.zh: 在多视角训练（ V max = 2 V_{\max}{=}2 ）中，我们使用完整的4轴划分 𝒜 = { t , i , j , v } \mathcal{A}\!=\!\{t,i,j,v\}：v 轴子块贡献其自身的旋转，而视角身份则由第 A.2 节中的每个子块的加性偏置额外提供（二者是互补的）。 在纯单视角运行中（ V = 1 V{=}1 ），v 轴子块不携带任何旋转，并保持为单位状态。 在执行 RoPE 旋转之前，动作和状态标记会从视觉板块中分离出来：只有 RoPE 的时间分量会对它们进行旋转（通过其步索引标识），从而确保每个步骤的单个本体感觉标记不会错误地继承空间位置。

paragraphs.en: The view information is encoded into the model in two ways. First, the view position encoding disambiguates different views of tokens with the same spatio-temporal position. This is achieved by rotating the view-axis sub-block ( d h / 4 d_{h}/4 channels per head). However, the view position only informs the model that two different views are distinct without any encoding of the type of the content (e.g. the model has to know which view represents the side camera looking from the left and which one is mounted on the wrist). One way of dealing with it is to just let the model learn this end-to-end; however, we decided to directly inject the view information as a learnable bias added across the full head width of visual-token queries and keys after the four-axis RoPE rotation:
paragraphs.zh: 视角信息通过两种方式编码到模型中。 首先，视角位置编码能够区分具有相同时空位置的标记的不同视角。 这是通过旋转视角轴子块（每个头 d h / 4 d_{h}/4 个通道）来实现的。 然而，视角位置仅告知模型两个不同视角是相互独立的，并未对内容类型进行任何编码（例如，模型必须知道哪个视角代表从左侧观察的侧摄像头，而哪个视角是安装在手腕上的）。 处理这一问题的一种方法就是让模型从头到尾自行学习；不过，我们决定将视角信息直接注入为可学习的偏置，在四轴 RoPE 旋转之后，将其加到视觉标记查询和键的整个头宽范围内：

paragraphs.en: We use a similar attention mask to V-JEPA 2-AC ( Assran et al., 2025 ) but extend it to multiple views: attention is timestep-level causal and restricted to a local temporal window of 8 8 timesteps, while within a step all V ​ H p ​ W p VH_{p}W_{p} visual tokens (plus the action and state tokens) attend omnidirectionally (any-to-any). More precisely, the rasterized sequence of tokens has T × N tok T\times N_{\text{tok}} tokens in total and the token at index k k can attend to tokens with indices j j such that ⌊ k N tok ⌋ − 7 ⩽ ⌊ j N tok ⌋ ⩽ ⌊ k N tok ⌋ \lfloor\frac{k}{N_{\text{tok}}}\rfloor-7\leqslant\lfloor\frac{j}{N_{\text{tok}}}\rfloor\leqslant\lfloor\frac{k}{N_{\text{tok}}}\rfloor . Schematically, this means that packing the sequence as T T frame-blocks of size N tok N_{\mathrm{tok}} given by Equation 20 , the attention mask between blocks is banded lower-triangular: each block of size N tok × N tok N_{\mathrm{tok}}{\times}N_{\mathrm{tok}} is fully attended within the diagonal band of width W t W_{t} and zero outside it. This trick makes the computational cost of attention grow linearly as a function of the step number and it alleviates the problem of the position extrapolation – the predicted content quality depends only on the accumulated error, not the ability of the model to extrapolate, because it never observes a sequence longer than the window size. This is a classical trick for language models and world models ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Po et al., 2025 ; PAN Team et al., 2025 ) . The bounded window keeps the per-step computational cost of attention constant and makes the predictor KV-cacheable in 𝒪 ⁡ ( W t ⋅ V ⋅ H p ⋅ W p ) \mathcal{O}(W_{t}\cdot V\cdot H_{p}\cdot W_{p}) keys per layer; Section 2.2 uses this at deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了与 V-JEPA 2-AC（Assran 等人，2025）类似的注意力掩码，但将其扩展到了多个视图：注意力在时间步层级上是因果的，并限制在一个包含 8 个时间步的局部时间窗口内；而在单个时间步内，所有 V​H​p​W​p​VH_{p}W_{p} 视觉标记（以及动作和状态标记）都以全向方式相互关注（任意到任意）。 更准确地说，经过光栅化的标记序列总共有 T×N​tok​T\times N_{\text{tok}} 个标记，其中索引为 k 的标记可以关注满足 ⌊k/N​tok​⌋−7≤⌊j/N​tok​⌋≤⌊k/N​tok​⌋⌊\frac{k}{N_{\text{tok}}}\rfloor-7\leqslant\lfloor\frac{j}{N_{\text{tok}}}\rfloor\leqslant\lfloor\frac{k}{N_{\text{tok}}}\rfloor 的索引为 j 的标记。 从示意图的角度来看，这意味着如果根据方程 20 将序列打包为大小为 N​tok​N_{\mathrm{tok}} 的 T 个帧块，那么块之间的注意力掩码将呈现带状下三角结构：每个大小为 N​tok​×N​tok​N_{\mathrm{tok}}{\times}N_{\mathrm{tok}} 的块在其宽度为 W​t​W_{t} 的对角带内完全相互关注，而带外则为零。 这种技巧使得注意力的计算成本随时间步数线性增长，并缓解了位置外推问题——预测内容的质量仅取决于累积误差，而非模型的外推能力，因为模型从未观察到超过窗口长度的序列。 这是语言模型和世界模型中一种经典的技巧（Assran 等人，2025；Po 等人，2025；PAN Team 等人，2025）。 有界窗口使每个时间步的注意力计算成本保持恒定，并使得预测器的 KV 缓存每层仅需 𝒪⁡(W​t​⋅V⋅H​p​⋅W​p​)\mathcal{O}(W_{t}\cdot V\cdot H_{p}\cdot W_{p}) 个键；第 2.2 节在实际部署中采用了这一方法。

paragraphs.en: The action token participates in self-attention as a regular token: the projected vector ActTok ⁡ ( a t , e ) \mathrm{ActTok}(a_{t},e) is concatenated to the per-step token bag and attends to (and is attended by) all visual and state tokens of the same step, and all visual / action / state tokens within the local temporal window W t W_{t} . The state token participates symmetrically. Token-style conditioning, in contrast to additive action embedding, lets the predictor express step-dependent gating of action effects (e.g., the gripper acting differently early vs. late in a grasp) without inflating the per-step input dimensionality.

paragraphs.en: For most datasets, the per-step action is the difference between consecutive states (which we refer to as the state-delta action): whether it is an end-effector (EEF) absolute pose, absolute joint angles, a commanded motion, or any combination of those for multiarm or wheeled robots. The same demonstration can often be described through several such parameterisations at once (for example joint angle control or EEF pose control), and each one shows the world model the same behavior from a different control perspective, acting as an action-level augmentation. We exploit this: we found it beneficial to train on different action parameterisations of the same embodiment whenever they are available. For example, with the DROID dataset arm we cannot only train on state-delta of the end-effector but also on the velocities of the end-effector or joint angles. Early in the work, we found that this improves the world model at a fixed training compute budget.
paragraphs.zh: 对于大多数数据集，每一步的动作是连续状态之间的差异（我们称之为“状态差分动作”）：无论是末端执行器（EEF）的绝对姿态、绝对关节角度、指令运动，还是多臂机器人或轮式机器人的这些要素的任何组合。 同一演示通常可以通过多种此类参数化方式同时描述（例如关节角度控制或 EEF 姿态控制），而每种参数化都从不同的控制视角向世界模型展示相同的行为，从而起到动作层面的增强作用。 我们利用了这一点：我们发现，只要可用，使用同一具身体不同动作参数化的版本进行训练是有益的。 例如，对于 DROID 数据集的手臂部分，我们不仅可以在末端执行器的状态差分上进行训练，还可以在其速度或关节角度上进行训练。 在研究初期，我们发现这种方法能在固定的训练计算预算下提升世界模型的性能。

Therefore, the world model has more potential to learn the underlying physics and dynamics of the world than with one embodiment. paragraphs.en: We use a lean per-embodiment linear projection of actions to facilitate learning a shared latent action tokenization within the world model. The dimensionality of the actions also varies. For the single-arm end-effector delta poses, we use seven dimensions that represent a 6 6 D translation+rotation and gripper closure. For dual arm platforms (e.g. AgileX in RoboMind or AgiBot World), this gets doubled since we have to control two arms independently. For wheeled platforms, the action space is extended by the commanded actions for the wheeled navigation - for example the RoboCasa platform reserves four actions for navigation atop the standard 7 7 D EEF control and 1X reserves 2 2 D for navigation (see more details in Tables 7 and B.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用一种精简的、每个具身化实例独立的线性动作投影，以在世界模型中促进共享的潜在动作标记化学习。 动作的维度也存在差异。 对于单臂末端执行器的增量位姿，我们使用七个维度来表示 6D 平移+旋转以及夹爪闭合。 对于双臂平台（例如： RoboMind 中的 AgileX 或 AgiBot World），这一数值会翻倍，因为我们需要独立控制两条手臂。 对于轮式平台，动作空间会扩展为包含轮式导航的指令动作——例如，RoboCasa 平台为标准 7D EEF 控制额外预留了四个导航动作，而 1X 则预留了 2D 用于导航（更多细节请参见表 7 和表 B.7）。
