paragraphs.en: To facilitate efficient training, we convert all datasets into the unified data format. Since datasets are collected with different sensor frequencies, loading continuous chunks of data would often lead to an overly short horizon for prediction. Additionally, different datasets have different motion velocities due to differences in data collection mechnisms – often different teleoperated platforms scale human motion to a faster or slower motion of the robot. Therefore, we employ different frame sampling frequencies for different datasets which we report in Table 7 (see Section B.6 for details). Each frame is processed via the image embedding of the V-JEPA 2.1 recipe ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , whose features performed strongly in policy-based evaluations of latent diffusion world models ( Nilaksh et al., 2026 ) on Bridge V2 ( Walke et al., 2023 ) . To correctly represent the total action between sampled frames, we either use the total measured state delta action or the concatenated chunk of commanded actions between sampled frames when working with commanded actions. The world model does not have a well-defined notion of modeling frequency. Instead, we simply let the world model integrate the total motion represented by the action into the next predicted latent state.
paragraphs.zh: 为便于高效训练，我们将所有数据集转换为统一的数据格式。 由于数据集是以不同传感器频率采集的，加载连续的数据片段通常会导致预测的时间范围过短。 此外，由于数据采集机制存在差异，不同数据集的运动速度也各不相同——不同的远程操作平台通常会将人类运动以更快或更慢的速度映射到机器人上。 因此，我们对不同数据集采用不同的帧采样频率，具体结果列于表 7（详见第 B.6 节）。 每一帧都通过 V-JEPA 2.1 方案中的图像嵌入方法进行处理（Mur-Labadia 等，2026），其特征在基于策略的潜在扩散世界模型评估中表现优异（Nilaksh 等，2026），测试平台为 Bridge V2（Walke 等，2023）。 为了正确表示采样帧之间的总动作，我们要么使用测得的总状态增量动作，要么在处理指令动作时使用采样帧之间指令动作的拼接片段。 该世界模型并没有明确定义建模频率的概念。 相反，我们只需让该世界模型将动作所表示的总运动整合到下一个预测的潜在状态中。

paragraphs.en: Every source dataset is re-packaged into a single object-storage layout so that the dataloader does not need per-source branching beyond a thin adapter that emits the standard tuple consumed by the predictor. Each trajectory exposes three groups: an MP4-encoded camera stream per view ( cameras/ ), HDF5 datasets holding the native proprioceptive vector ( trajectory/observation/robot_state/ ), and, when the source ships a controller stream, raw controller commands ( trajectory/action/ ). Episode-level metadata (e.g. DROID building / labs fields used by the negative filter that drops setup-room recordings) is recorded in a per-dataset aggregated_metadata.json ; a per-dataset index maps episode ids to S3 paths, episode lengths, and per-camera availability so the sampler operates on this index without touching object storage. Per-clip sampling reads T = 16 T{=}16 frames at the world-model rate ( Section B.6 ) and V V cameras ( Section B.9 ); intrinsics, extrinsics, and uncalibrated metadata are loaded as NaN-filled placeholders and discarded by the predictor in this configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 每个源数据集都被重新打包为单一的对象存储布局，这样数据加载器就不需要在预测器所消耗的标准元组之外，针对每个数据源进行额外的分支处理。 每条轨迹暴露出三组内容：每个视角的 MP4 编码摄像头流（cameras/）、包含原始本体感觉向量的 HDF5 数据集（trajectory/observation/robot_state/），以及当源数据提供控制器流时，还包括原始的控制器命令（trajectory/action/）。 片段级元数据（例如： DROID 建筑 / 实验室字段，这些字段被负样本过滤器用于排除设置房间的录像）记录在每个数据集的 aggregated_metadata.json 文件中；每个数据集的索引将片段 ID 映射到 S3 路径、片段长度以及各摄像头的可用性信息，这样采样器就可以基于该索引操作，而无需访问对象存储。 每个剪辑的采样以世界模型速率读取 T = 16 T{=}16 帧（第 B.6 节）和 V V 个摄像头（第 B.9 节）；在此配置中，内参、外参以及未校准的元数据会被加载为填充 NaN 的占位符，并由预测器丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Every source is emitted as one MP4 per view at its native frame rate ( Table 7 ). Most OXE ( Open X-Embodiment Collaboration et al., 2023 ) sources ship RLDS/TFDS records with per-step RGB arrays, which we re-encode to MP4 (e.g. 1 1 fps for RoboNet ( Dasari et al., 2019 ) , 5 5 fps for Bridge ( Ebert et al., 2022 ) /MT-Opt ( Kalashnikov et al., 2021 ) /Language-Table ( Lynch et al., 2023 ) , 10 10 fps for RT-1 ( Brohan et al., 2023 ) /QT-Opt ( Kalashnikov et al., 2018 ) /BC-Z ( Jang et al., 2022 ) /FMB ( Luo et al., 2024 ) ). RoboMind ( Wu et al., 2024b ) stores each frame as a JPEG byte-string inside HDF5: we decode every frame individually, falling back to a raw-buffer reshape ( 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 or 480 × 640 480{\times}640 ) when the JPEG header is missing, and correct the channel order from BGR to RGB for the real Franka streams (the simulated streams are already RGB). For DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) we discard the stereo/SVO recordings and keep the rectified monocular left, right, and wrist MP4 streams. For sources with multiple nominal cameras we detect and drop all-zero (absent) camera streams so they are not written as empty views (e.g. the unused auxiliary cameras in Bridge V2 ( Walke et al., 2023 ) ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个数据源都以其原始帧率生成一个 MP4 文件，对应于每次观察（表 7）。 大多数 OXE（Open X-Embodiment Collaboration 等，2023）数据源都附带了按步骤记录的 RGB 数组的 RLDS/TFDS 记录，我们将其重新编码为 MP4（例如，RoboNet（Dasari 等，2019）为 1 fps，Bridge（Ebert 等，2022）/MT-Opt（Kalashnikov 等，2021）/Language-Table（Lynch 等，2023）为 5 fps，RT-1（Brohan 等，2023）/QT-Opt（Kalashnikov 等，2018）/BC-Z（Jang 等，2022）/FMB（Luo 等，2024）为 10 fps）。 RoboMind（Wu 等，2024b）将每一帧存储为 HDF5 中的 JPEG 字节字符串：我们会对每一帧进行单独解码；如果缺少 JPEG 文件头，则回退到原始缓冲区的重塑（720 × 1280 或 480 × 640），并对真实的 Franka 流将通道顺序从 BGR 修正为 RGB（模拟流已经是 RGB）。 对于 DROID（Khazatsky 等，2024），我们丢弃立体/SVO 记录，仅保留经过校正的单目左、右和手腕 MP4 流。 对于具有多个名义摄像头的数据源，我们会检测并删除全零（缺失）的摄像头流，以免它们被写入为空的观察（例如 Bridge V2（Walke 等，2023）中未使用的辅助摄像头）。

paragraphs.en: Roboset ( Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ) and LeRobot ( Cadene et al., 2024 ) record only joint encoders, with no end-effector pose. We reconstruct the end-effector Cartesian pose with a differentiable forward-kinematics model of the corresponding arm (a Franka Panda for Roboset, the SO-101 URDF for LeRobot), applied to both the state trajectory and, for Roboset, the commanded-joint trajectory to recover a Cartesian action. LeRobot joint encoders are first converted from degrees to radians. For Roboset we additionally apply constant per-joint offsets (a + π / 2 +\pi/2 shift on the wrist joints of both state and action, and a − π / 2 -\pi/2 shift on one action joint) so that the joint zero convention matches the URDF used by the kinematics model.
paragraphs.zh: Roboset（Bharadhwaj 等人，2024）和 LeRobot（Cadene 等人，2024）仅记录关节编码器数据，不包含末端执行器的位姿信息。 我们利用对应机械臂的可微分正向运动学模型来重建末端执行器的笛卡尔位姿（Roboset 使用 Franka Panda，LeRobot 使用 SO-101 URDF），并将该模型同时应用于状态轨迹以及 Roboset 的指令关节轨迹，以恢复出笛卡尔动作。 LeRobot 的关节编码器数据首先从角度（度）转换为弧度（弧度）。 对于 Roboset，我们还额外对每个关节应用了固定的偏移量（状态和动作中手腕关节均偏移 +π/2，而其中一个动作关节则偏移 −π/2），以使关节零点的约定与运动学模型所使用的 URDF 保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Sources that store the end-effector orientation as a quaternion (RT-1, QT-Opt, MT-Opt, FMB, the simulated RoboMind Franka split) and the forward-kinematics outputs above are all converted to an x ​ y ​ z xyz Euler parameterisation, so that the entire mixture shares a single 3 3 -D translation + + 3 3 -D Euler orientation convention for end-effector poses.
paragraphs.zh: 将末端执行器姿态以四元数形式存储的数据源（RT-1、QT-Opt、MT-Opt、FMB，以及模拟的 RoboMind Franka 分割数据）和上述正向运动学输出，均转换为 x y z xyz 欧拉参数化形式，从而确保整个混合数据集对末端执行器姿态采用统一的 3-D 平移 + 3-D 欧拉姿态表示方式。

paragraphs.en: Gripper signals are placed on a common [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] closedness scale. Roboset state grippers are divided by their observed open width ( 0.8305 0.8305 ) and clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and its command grippers are affinely mapped from [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . WidowX sources (Bridge and Bridge V2) invert and clip the raw gripper signal, g ← 1 − clip ⁡ ( g , 0 , 1 ) g\leftarrow 1-\mathrm{clip}(g,0,1) , so that larger values consistently denote a more closed gripper.
paragraphs.zh: 夹爪信号被置于一个共同的 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 闭合度标度上。 Roboset 状态夹爪根据其观测到的张开宽度（ 0.8305 0.8305 ）进行划分，并裁剪至 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1]；其指令夹爪则通过仿射映射从 [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] 转换到 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1]。 WidowX 信号源（Bridge 和 Bridge V2）会对原始夹爪信号进行反转和裁剪，即 g ← 1 − clip ⁡ ( g , 0 , 1 ) g\leftarrow 1-\mathrm{clip}(g,0,1)，从而使得较大的数值始终表示夹爪处于更闭合的状态。

paragraphs.en: Bimanual and humanoid embodiments are assembled into a single per-step vector. For the RoboMind AgileX dual-arm platform we concatenate the left and right end-effector poses and the left and right arm joints, taking each arm’s last joint as its gripper. Bridge (v1) actions, which are stored as separate translation and rotation-delta fields, are concatenated into a single delta-pose action vector, and BC-Z end-effector poses are assembled from separately stored translation and axis-angle observations.
paragraphs.zh: 双手和类人形态的实体被整合为一个单步向量。 对于 RoboMind AgileX 双臂平台，我们将左右末端执行器的位姿以及左右手臂的关节连接起来，并将每只手臂的最后一个关节视为其抓取器。 Bridge (v1) 的动作以独立的平移和旋转增量字段存储，随后被连接为一个单一的增量位姿动作向量；而 BC-Z 末端执行器的位姿则从分别存储的平移和轴角观测数据中整合而成。

paragraphs.en: At deployment the Franka controller of Section 2.2 runs at f ctrl = 10 f_{\text{ctrl}}{=}10 Hz while the world model operates at f wm = 5 f_{\text{wm}}{=}5 Hz. paragraphs.zh: 在部署阶段，第 2.2 节中的 Franka 控制器以 f ctrl = 10 f_{\text{ctrl}}{=}10 Hz 运行，而世界模型则以 f wm = 5 f_{\text{wm}}{=}5 Hz 运行。 规划器每隔一次控制器计时步进行重新规划，规划器返回的 7 7 -D 末端执行器增量被拆分为 f ctrl / f wm = 2 f_{\text{ctrl}}/f_{\text{wm}}{=}2 个相等的子步，并连续发出；这使得训练和部署保持在相同的 200 200 ms 预测器步长上同步，同时将控制器与世界模型的运行速率隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: For most datasets the per-step action is computed as a finite difference of the synchronized state trajectory: Δ ​ x t ∈ ℝ 3 \Delta x_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} for the end-effector position, Δ ​ R t ∈ 𝔰 ​ 𝔬 ​ ( 3 ) \Delta R_{t}\in\mathfrak{so}(3) for orientation (computed in the Lie algebra so that the magnitude is independent of the rotation representation used by the source), and a scalar Δ ​ g t \Delta g_{t} for the gripper. The vector concatenates these into a per-platform native width: 7 7 -D for the standard Franka / Bridge / Kuka end-effector, 14 14 -D for AgileX (two end-effectors), 23 23 -D for AgiBot dual-arm, 25 25 -D for the 1X humanoid, and so on across the mixture.
paragraphs.zh: 对于大多数数据集，每一步的动作都通过同步状态轨迹的有限差分计算得出：末端执行器位置为 Δ x t ∈ ℝ 3 \Delta x_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3}，姿态为 Δ R t ∈ 𝔰 𝔬 ( 3 ) \Delta R_{t}\in\mathfrak{so}(3)（在李代数中计算，以确保其大小与源数据使用的旋转表示无关），而夹具则为一个标量 Δ g t \Delta g_{t}。 该向量将这些值拼接成每个平台固有的宽度：标准 Franka / Bridge / Kuka 末端执行器为 7 7 -D，AgileX（两个末端执行器）为 14 14 -D，AgiBot 双臂机器人为 23 23 -D，1X 人形机器人则为 25 25 -D，混合数据集中的其他情况也依此类推。

paragraphs.en: For datasets that ship a high-rate controller stream — DROID (four cartesian / joint, position / velocity variants) and RoboCasa (cartesian-position) — the loader instead reads the raw controller stream at f raw f_{\text{raw}} and concatenates the f raw / f wm f_{\text{raw}}/f_{\text{wm}} sub-step commands within one world-model step into a single per-step vector. For DROID at → 7.5 60\!\to\!7.5 Hz this yields a chunk of 8 8 controller commands per predictor step (up to 8 × 8 = 64 8{\times}8{=}64 dimensions); for RoboCasa at → 5 20\!\to\!5 Hz it yields a chunk of 4 4 commands. This recovers the high-frequency controller signal (which the world model must match if its rollout is to drive a downstream planner — Section 2.2 ) without changing the f wm f_{\text{wm}} stride at which video features are produced.
paragraphs.zh: 对于提供高频率控制器流的数据集——DROID（四种笛卡尔/关节、位置/速度变体）和 RoboCasa（笛卡尔位置）——加载器会读取原始控制器流 f raw f_{\text{raw}}，并将一个世界模型步长内的 f raw / f wm f_{\text{raw}}/f_{\text{wm}} 子步指令拼接成一个单步向量。 对于 DROID 在 → 7.5 60\!\to\!7.5 Hz 的情况，每个预测步长会产生一个包含 8 个控制器指令的片段（最多为 8 × 8 = 64 8{\times}8{=}64 维）；对于 RoboCasa 在 → 5 20\!\to\!5 Hz 的情况，则会产生一个包含 4 个指令的片段。 这样可以在不改变生成视频特征的 f wm f_{\text{wm}} 步长的情况下，恢复高频控制器信号（如果世界模型的模拟结果要驱动下游规划器，就必须匹配该信号——第 2.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: To batch heterogeneous embodiments together within a single rank’s microbatch, every per-step action vector — whether a single state-delta or an action-key chunk — is right-zero-padded to the fixed width d a max = 64 d_{a}^{\max}{=}64 used by the predictor’s per-embodiment input projection. The width 64 64 is chosen jointly to absorb the widest native state-delta (the 25 25 -D 1X humanoid) and the largest action-key chunk emitted by the pipeline above. The per-embodiment projection W a ( e ) ∈ ℝ D × d a max W_{a}^{(e)}\!\in\!\mathbb{R}^{D\times d_{a}^{\max}} is a multi-embodiment linear (a single | ℰ | × D × d a max |\mathcal{E}|\!\times\!D\!\times\!d_{a}^{\max} weight tensor indexed by embodiment id) that recovers the native action space from the padded slot. The same construction is mirrored on the proprioceptive side ( d s max d_{s}^{\max} , W s ( e ) W_{s}^{(e)} ); the action and state tokens enter the predictor as n a = n s = 1 n_{a}{=}n_{s}{=}1 tokens per step in Equation 20 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了将异构的具身化实例在单个秩的微批次中批量组合，每个步骤的动作向量——无论是单一的状态差异，还是动作键片段——都会被右零填充至预测器每个具身化输入投影所使用的固定宽度 d a max = 64 d_{a}^{\max}{=}64。 宽度 64 64 的选择兼顾了最宽的原生状态差异（25 25 -D 1X 类人形态）以及上述流程输出的最大动作键片段。 每个具身化的投影 W a ( e ) ∈ ℝ D × d a max W_{a}^{(e)}\!\in\!\mathbb{R}^{D\times d_{a}^{\max}} 是一个多具身化线性映射（一个由具身化 ID 索引的 | ℰ | × D × d a max |\mathcal{E}|\!\times\!D\!\times\!d_{a}^{\max} 权重张量），它可从填充后的槽位中恢复原始动作空间。 同样的结构也应用于本体感觉侧（d s max d_{s}^{\max}，W s ( e ) W_{s}^{(e)}）；在方程 20 中，动作和状态标记以每个步骤 n a = n s = 1 n_{a}{=}n_{s}{=}1 个标记的形式进入预测器。

paragraphs.en: The video tensor returned by the loader has shape [ C , V , T , H img , W img ] [C,V,T,H_{\text{img}},W_{\text{img}}] with C = 3 C{=}3 , V ∈ { 1 , 2 } V\!\in\!\{1,2\} and T = 16 T{=}16 frames at f wm f_{\text{wm}} . Spatial cropping follows the V-JEPA 2.1 input recipe ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) : at training time each clip is randomly resized with aspect ratio sampled from [ 1.333 , 1.777 ] [1.333,1.777] and area scale sampled from [ 0.5 , 1.0 ] [0.5,1.0] , then center-cropped to 240 × 320 240{\times}320 , while at evaluation we use a deterministic 1.0 / 1.0 1.0/1.0 -scale crop of the same size. Random horizontal flips, auto-augmentation, motion shift and random erasing are disabled to avoid distorting end-effector geometry. Frames are normalized with the standard ImageNet statistics ( Deng et al., 2009 ) expected by the V-JEPA 2.1 encoder ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , and the resulting 240 × 320 240{\times}320 tensor is fed to the frozen encoder which produces an H p × W p = 15 × 20 H_{p}{\times}W_{p}{=}15{\times}20 patch grid with D e = 1664 D_{e}{=}1664 channels per patch.
paragraphs.zh: 加载器返回的视频张量形状为 [ C , V , T , H img , W img ] [C,V,T,H_{\text{img}},W_{\text{img}}]，其中 C = 3 C{=}3，V ∈ { 1 , 2 } V\!\in\!\{1,2\}，T = 16 T{=}16 帧，帧率为 f wm f_{\text{wm}}。 空间裁剪遵循 V-JEPA 2.1 的输入方案（Mur-Labadia 等，2026）：训练时，每个剪辑片段会随机调整大小，其纵横比从 [ 1.333 , 1.777 ] [1.333,1.777] 中采样，面积缩放因子从 [ 0.5 , 1.0 ] [0.5,1.0] 中采样，然后以中心为基准裁剪至 240 × 320 240{\times}320；而评估时，我们使用相同尺寸的确定性 1.0 / 1.0 1.0/1.0 缩放裁剪。 为避免扭曲末端执行器的几何结构，随机水平翻转、自动增强、运动偏移和随机擦除功能均已禁用。 帧使用 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器（Mur-Labadia 等，2026）所期望的标准 ImageNet 统计数据（Deng 等，2009）进行归一化，随后将得到的 240 × 320 240{\times}320 张量输入到冻结编码器中，该编码器生成一个 H p × W p = 15 × 20 H_{p}{\times}W_{p}{=}15{\times}20 的图像块网格，每个图像块的通道数为 D e = 1664 D_{e}{=}1664。

paragraphs.en: We use data parallelism for models up to 2 2 B parameters and FSDP2 for the 4 4 B and 8 8 B models during pretraining and short-horizon prediction training. For long-horizon prediction finetuning, we instead use data parallelism combined with tensor parallelism ( tp = 2 \mathrm{tp}{=}2 ) for the 4 4 B and 8 8 B models. Sharing each sequence across two tensor-parallel GPUs allows an effective per-GPU batch size below one sequence in the most memory-intensive group (two-view, high-resolution), accommodating the K = 10 K{=}10 autoregressive rollout used during this cooldown.
paragraphs.zh: 在预训练和短时程预测训练中，对于参数规模不超过 22 B 的模型，我们使用数据并行；而对于 44 B 和 88 B 模型，则使用 FSDP2。 对于长时程预测的微调，我们转而对 44 B 和 88 B 模型采用数据并行与张量并行（tp = 2 \mathrm{tp}{=}2）相结合的方法。 将每个序列共享给两个张量并行 GPU，使得在内存消耗最大的组别（双视图、高分辨率）中，每个 GPU 的有效批量大小可以低于一个序列，从而能够支持在此冷却阶段使用的 K = 10 K{=}10 自回归展开。

paragraphs.en: The schedule of Section 2.2 is warmup–stable–decay (WSD) ( Hu et al., 2024 ) : warmup linear → η 0\!\to\!\eta , then a long stable phase held flat at η = 5 × 10 − 5 \eta{=}5{\times}10^{-5} , then a cooldown (decay) phase. We do not run cooldown inline; instead we resume the final stable-phase checkpoint as a fresh job that (i) swaps the optimizer schedulers to a linear LR cooldown paired with a constant weight-decay schedule, (ii) raises the autoregressive rollout horizon from K ar = 2 K_{\mathrm{ar}}{=}2 to K ar = 10 K_{\mathrm{ar}}{=}10 , and (iii) re-partitions the ranks into four view × \times resolution groups. The LR decays as η t = η ⁡ ( 1 − min ⁡ ( t , N cool ) / N cool ) \eta_{t}=\eta\,(1-\min(t,N_{\mathrm{cool}})/N_{\mathrm{cool}}) with N cool = 5000 N_{\mathrm{cool}}{=}5000 optimizer steps, reaching 0 0 at the end; weight decay stays at 0.1 0.1 throughout (the cooldown is a pure LR sweep), and the per-group μ \mu P lr_scale factors are preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2.2 节的调度方案为“预热–稳定–衰减”（WSD）（Hu et al., 2024）：线性预热阶段 η 从 0 逐渐增至 η₀，随后进入一个在 η = 5 × 10⁻⁵ 处保持恒定的长时间稳定阶段，最后进入冷却（衰减）阶段。 我们不会在线内执行冷却阶段；相反，我们会将最终稳定阶段的检查点作为新任务重新运行，该任务会：(i) 将优化器调度器切换为线性学习率冷却方案，并搭配恒定的权重衰减调度；(ii) 将自回归展开步数从 K_ar = 2 提升至 K_ar = 10；以及 (iii) 将秩重新划分为四个“视图 × 分辨率”组。 学习率按 η_t = η × (1 − min(t, N_cool) / N_cool) 进行衰减，其中 N_cool = 5000 个优化器步数，最终降至 0；权重衰减在整个过程中保持为 0.1（冷却阶段仅为学习率的线性扫描），且各组的 μ P_lr_scale 因子保持不变。

paragraphs.en: During cooldown the two view-groups of Section C.1 are each split by input resolution, giving four groups that evenly partition the world ( 25 % 25\% of ranks each on the 128 128 -rank 1B cooldown): two-view 240 × 320 240{\times}320 , two-view 480 × 640 480{\times}640 , one-view 240 × 320 240{\times}320 , and one-view 480 × 640 480{\times}640 . The predictor and the frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder are unchanged: at 480 × 640 480{\times}640 the encoder’s 16 × 16 16{\times}16 patching yields a 30 × 40 30{\times}40 grid, i.e. H p ​ W p = 1200 H_{p}W_{p}{=}1200 tokens per view per frame versus 300 300 at 240 × 320 240{\times}320 (a 4 × 4\times increase), and the predictor’s factorised RoPE ( Section A.1 ) interpolates to the larger grid with no new parameters. High-resolution groups use a smaller per-rank batch and matched gradient accumulation to keep per-GPU memory within budget; the gradient-synchronization machinery is unchanged, now aggregating four groups instead of two in the single per-step all-reduce.

paragraphs.en: We additionally finetune a high-resolution DROID world model. It initializes from the 8 8 B long-horizon prediction training checkpoint at 300,000 300{,}000 pretraining steps ( Section J.3 ), and the only things we change relative to the scaling runs are the input resolution and the number of views. Training uses DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) only, with three fixed views at 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 resolution over 16 16 timesteps. The three views are the exterior-left, exterior-right, and wrist cameras, selected in this fixed order; this is unlike pretraining, where the views are sampled in a random order. With patch size 16 16 , each 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 view becomes a 45 × 80 = 3,600 45{\times}80{=}3{,}600 -token grid, so a full sequence is about 170,000 170{,}000 input tokens. At this resolution the model would also generate more than 10,000 10{,}000 tokens per forward pass, which highlights the utility of a feedforward world model that predicts all next-frame tokens in one pass.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还对高分辨率的 DROID 世界模型进行了微调。 该模型从 88B 长时程预测训练检查点（在 300,000 个预训练步骤处，见 J.3 节）初始化；与扩展运行相比，我们唯一更改的输入是分辨率和视角数量。 训练仅使用 DROID（Khazatsky 等人，2024），采用 720 × 1280 分辨率的三个固定视角，跨越 16 个时间步。 这三个视角分别是外部左侧、外部右侧和手腕摄像头，且按此固定顺序选择；这与预训练不同，在预训练中视角是按随机顺序采样的。 当块大小为 16 时，每个 720 × 1280 的视角会变成一个 45 × 80 = 3,600 个标记的网格，因此一个完整序列约有 170,000 个输入标记。 在此分辨率下，模型每次前向传播也会生成超过 10,000 个标记，这凸显了前馈世界模型的实用性——它能在单次传播中预测下一帧的所有标记。

paragraphs.en: The world model produces dense V-JEPA features at f wm = 5 f_{\mathrm{wm}}{=}5 Hz, i.e. one feature frame for every fourth RGB frame; the Cosmos tokenizer compresses the raw video time axis by 4 × 4{\times} , so each Cosmos latent frame aligns with exactly one V-JEPA frame. The decoder therefore does two jobs at once — reconstruct the appearance the V-JEPA features already encode, and imagine the three RGB frames of motion between consecutive V-JEPA frames. Because f wm f_{\mathrm{wm}} is low, the inter-frame motion the decoder needs to fabricate is small, which is why a relatively small DiT ( ∼ 800 {\sim}800 M parameters) suffices for 240 × 320 240{\times}320 video.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型以 f wm = 5 f_{\mathrm{wm}}{=}5 Hz 的频率生成密集的 V-JEPA 特征，即每四个 RGB 帧对应一个特征帧；Cosmos 分词器将原始视频的时间轴压缩了 4 × 4{\times}，因此每个 Cosmos 潜在帧都精确对应一个 V-JEPA 帧。 因此，解码器同时执行两项任务：重建 V-JEPA 特征已编码的外观，并构想连续 V-JEPA 帧之间的三个 RGB 运动帧。 由于 f wm f_{\mathrm{wm}} 较低，解码器需要生成的帧间运动量很小，因此对于 240 × 320 240{\times}320 的视频而言，一个相对较小的 DiT（约 800 {\sim}800 M 参数）就足够了。

paragraphs.en: The decoder D ϕ D_{\phi} is used only for visualization : it is never invoked inside CEM, and no gradient flows between it and the world model. Its training data is exclusively frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder features ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) ; the encoder, the predictor of Section 2.1 , and both halves of the Cosmos-0.1-Tokenizer-CV4x8x8 ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) are all frozen, and the only trainable parameters are those of D ϕ D_{\phi} itself.
paragraphs.zh: 解码器 D ϕ D_{\phi} 仅用于可视化：它从未在 CEM 内部被调用，且与世界模型之间没有梯度流动。 其训练数据完全由冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器特征组成（Mur-Labadia 等，2026）；编码器、第 2.1 节的预测器以及 Cosmos-0.1-Tokenizer-CV4x8x8 的两个部分（NVIDIA，2025）均被冻结，唯一可训练的参数是 D ϕ D_{\phi} 本身的参数。

paragraphs.zh: 在整个附录中，解码器剪辑跨越 T dec = 8 个 V-JEPA 步骤（在我们的实验中 T_{\text{dec}}{=}8），而 ν ∈ { 0 , … , T dec } \nu\!\in\!\{0,\dots,T_{\text{dec}}\} 用于索引其帧（我们将符号 f 保留给冻结的 V-JEPA 编码器）。 为保持两个网格完全对齐，数据加载器会同时以两种帧率加载视频：一个高帧率流包含 4 T dec + 1 个 RGB 帧，由 Cosmos 编码器压缩成待去噪的潜在表示；另一个低帧率流则每隔一帧取一次，即 T dec + 1 个 RGB 帧（0, 4, …, 4 T dec），由 V-JEPA 编码器转换为条件特征。 由于 Cosmos 分词器在空间上以 8 × 的比例下采样，在时间上以 4 × 的比例下采样，并且单独编码第一帧，因此 4 T dec + 1 个 RGB 帧会产生 T dec + 1 个形状为 H p × W p、具有 16 个潜在通道的 Cosmos 潜在帧。 帧率乘数等于分词器 4 × 的时间压缩比，因此每个 Cosmos 潜在帧 ν 都精确对应一个 V-JEPA 帧 z ν；当 T dec = 8 时，该剪辑包含 9 个 V-JEPA 帧（RGB 帧 0, 4, …, 32）、33 个 RGB 帧和 9 个 Cosmos 潜在帧。 在这样经过 8 × 8 × 4 压缩的潜在空间中操作，而不是直接在像素上操作，使得在单个节点上训练用于 240 × 320 视频的 Transformer 去噪器成为可能。

sents.en: Throughout this appendix a decoder clip spans T dec T_{\text{dec}} V-JEPA steps ( T dec = 8 T_{\text{dec}}{=}8 in our experiments) and ν ∈ { 0 , … , T dec } \nu\!\in\!\{0,\dots,T_{\text{dec}}\} indexes its frames (we reserve the symbol f f for the frozen V-JEPA encoder).
sents.zh: 在整个附录中，解码器剪辑跨越 T dec = 8 个 V-JEPA 步骤（在我们的实验中 T_{\text{dec}}{=}8），而 ν ∈ { 0 , … , T dec } \nu\!\in\!\{0,\dots,T_{\text{dec}}\} 用于索引其帧（我们将符号 f 保留给冻结的 V-JEPA 编码器）。

sents.en: To keep the two grids exactly aligned, the dataloader loads video at two frame rates simultaneously: a high-fps stream of 4 ​ T dec + 1 4T_{\text{dec}}{+}1 RGB frames that the Cosmos encoder compresses into the latents to be denoised, and a low-fps stream of every fourth frame, i.e. the T dec + 1 T_{\text{dec}}{+}1 RGB frames 0 , 4 , … , 4 ​ T dec 0,4,\dots,4T_{\text{dec}} , that the V-JEPA encoder turns into conditioning features.
sents.zh: 为保持两个网格完全对齐，数据加载器会同时以两种帧率加载视频：一个高帧率流包含 4 T dec + 1 个 RGB 帧，由 Cosmos 编码器压缩成待去噪的潜在表示；另一个低帧率流则每隔一帧取一次，即 T dec + 1 个 RGB 帧（0, 4, …, 4 T dec），由 V-JEPA 编码器转换为条件特征。

sents.en: Because the Cosmos tokenizer downsamples space by 8 × 8\times and time by 4 × 4\times , encoding the first frame on its own, the 4 ​ T dec + 1 4T_{\text{dec}}{+}1 RGB frames yield T dec + 1 T_{\text{dec}}{+}1 Cosmos latent frames of shape H p × W p H_{p}{\times}W_{p} with 16 latent channels.
sents.zh: 由于 Cosmos 分词器在空间上以 8 × 的比例下采样，在时间上以 4 × 的比例下采样，并且单独编码第一帧，因此 4 T dec + 1 个 RGB 帧会产生 T dec + 1 个形状为 H p × W p、具有 16 个潜在通道的 Cosmos 潜在帧。

sents.en: The frame-rate multiplier equals the tokenizer’s 4 × 4{\times} temporal compression, so each Cosmos latent frame ν \nu corresponds to exactly one V-JEPA frame z ν z_{\nu} ; for T dec = 8 T_{\text{dec}}{=}8 the clip has 9 9 V-JEPA frames (RGB frames 0 , 4 , … , 32 0,4,\dots,32 ), 33 33 RGB frames and 9 9 Cosmos latent frames.
sents.zh: 帧率乘数等于分词器 4 × 的时间压缩比，因此每个 Cosmos 潜在帧 ν 都精确对应一个 V-JEPA 帧 z ν；当 T dec = 8 时，该剪辑包含 9 个 V-JEPA 帧（RGB 帧 0, 4, …, 32）、33 个 RGB 帧和 9 个 Cosmos 潜在帧。

sents.en: Operating in this 8 × 8 × 4 8{\times}8{\times}4 -compressed latent space, rather than on pixels, is what makes training a transformer denoiser on 240 × 320 240{\times}320 video tractable on a single node.
sents.zh: 在这样经过 8 × 8 × 4 压缩的潜在空间中操作，而不是直接在像素上操作，使得在单个节点上训练用于 240 × 320 视频的 Transformer 去噪器成为可能。

paragraphs.en: D ϕ D_{\phi} is a PixArt-style diffusion transformer ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ) with L = 32 L{=}32 blocks of hidden dimension d = 1280 d{=}1280 . Each block uses grouped-query attention ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) with 20 20 query heads and 10 10 KV heads, an MLP ratio of 4.0 4.0 , and rotary position embeddings ( Su et al., 2024 ) on the attention queries and keys. Self-attention is restricted to a local temporal window of W τ = 4 W_{\tau}{=}4 Cosmos frames (full attention across the spatial H p × W p H_{p}{\times}W_{p} grid), which keeps the computational cost per token linear in the clip length and admits an efficient block-sparse mask while encouraging local temporal coherence. This W τ = 4 W_{\tau}{=}4 window acts on Cosmos latents (themselves 4 × 4{\times} temporally compressed) and is distinct from the predictor’s W t = 8 W_{t}{=}8 -V-JEPA-frame window of Section 2.1 .
paragraphs.zh: D ϕ D_{\phi} 是一个 PixArt 风格的扩散变换器（Peebles 和 Xie，2023；Chen 等，2024b），包含 L = 32 个隐藏维度为 d = 1280 的模块。 每个模块使用分组查询注意力机制（Ainslie 等，2023），配备 20 个查询头和 10 个 KV 头，MLP 比例为 4.0，并在注意力查询和键上应用旋转位置嵌入（Su 等，2024）。 自注意力被限制在一个局部时间窗口内，即 W τ = 4 个 Cosmos 帧（在整个空间网格 H p × W p 上采用全注意力），这使得每个标记的计算成本与剪辑长度呈线性关系，同时支持高效的块稀疏掩码，并促进局部时间连贯性。 这个 W τ = 4 的窗口作用于 Cosmos 潜在表示（其本身在时间维度上已进行 4× 压缩），并且与第 2.1 节中预测器的 W t = 8 -V-JEPA-帧窗口不同。

sents.zh: D ϕ D_{\phi} 是一个 PixArt 风格的扩散变换器（Peebles 和 Xie，2023；Chen 等，2024b），包含 L = 32 个隐藏维度为 d = 1280 的模块。

sents.en: Each block uses grouped-query attention ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) with 20 20 query heads and 10 10 KV heads, an MLP ratio of 4.0 4.0 , and rotary position embeddings ( Su et al., 2024 ) on the attention queries and keys.

paragraphs.en: We use unweighted x 0 x_{0} -MSE, with no additional timestep-dependent weighting. For equivalent x 0 x_{0} and ϵ \epsilon predictions at 0 < α ¯ t < 1 0<\bar{\alpha}_{t}<1 , the squared errors satisfy ‖ x ^ 0 − x 0 ‖ 2 = 1 − α ¯ t α ¯ t ​ ‖ ϵ ^ − ϵ ‖ 2 \|\hat{x}_{0}-x_{0}\|^{2}=\frac{1-\bar{\alpha}_{t}}{\bar{\alpha}_{t}}\|\hat{\epsilon}-\epsilon\|^{2} . Thus, expressed as an ϵ \epsilon -prediction loss, this corresponds to inverse-SNR weighting, emphasizing high-noise rather than low-noise timesteps. The condition z z is dropped to the zero vector independently per sample with probability p drop = 0.1 p_{\text{drop}}{=}0.1 during training to support classifier-free guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) , although in practice we use a guidance scale of w = 1.0 w{=}1.0 (no guidance) by default since this is the most faithful for visualization. We use the log-SNR-parameterised cosine schedule of Simple Diffusion ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ) in preference to the cosine schedule of IDDPM ( Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021 ) : parameterising in log-SNR gives finer control over the signal-to-noise trajectory and avoids the degenerate near-zero-SNR behavior at t → K − 1 t\!\to\!K{-}1 that the IDDPM schedule exhibits. We use K = 1000 K{=}1000 training timesteps and enforce zero terminal SNR following Lin et al. (2024) ; the per-frame independent t ν t_{\nu} -sampling above is what makes the trained denoiser robust to mixed noise levels and, in turn, what enables prefix-conditioned generation at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用无加权的 x₀ -MSE，且没有额外的与时间步相关的加权。 对于在 0 < ᾱₜ < 1 条件下具有等效 x₀ 和 ϵ 预测值的情况，平方误差满足 ‖x̂₀ − x₀‖² = (1 − ᾱₜ)/ᾱₜ ‖ĕ − ϵ‖²。 因此，以 ϵ-预测损失的形式表达时，这对应于逆 SNR 加权，即更强调高噪声时间步而非低噪声时间步。 在训练期间，每个样本以 p_drop = 0.1 的概率独立地将 z 条件降至零向量，以支持无分类器引导（Ho 和 Salimans, 2022）；尽管在实践中，我们默认使用 w = 1.0 的引导尺度（即无引导），因为这对可视化最为忠实。 相比于 IDDPM（Nichol 和 Dhariwal, 2021）的余弦调度，我们优先采用 Simple Diffusion（Hoogeboom 等, 2023）中基于 log-SNR 参数化的余弦调度：以 log-SNR 进行参数化能更精细地控制信噪比轨迹，并避免了 IDDPM 调度在 t → K−1 时出现的退化的接近零的 SNR 行为。 我们使用 K = 1000 个训练时间步，并遵循 Lin 等（2024）的方法强制终端 SNR 为零。 上述每帧独立的 t_ν-采样是使训练后的去噪器对混合噪声水平具有鲁棒性的关键，进而也使得推理时能够进行前缀条件生成。

paragraphs.en: Despite training with K = 1000 K{=}1000 DDPM steps, at inference we run only 2 DDIM steps ( Song et al., 2021 ) from x K − 1 ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) x_{K-1}\!\sim\!\mathcal{N}(0,I) per Cosmos frame and pipe the result through the frozen Cosmos decoder to pixels. We attribute this to the strength of the V-JEPA conditioning: dense V-JEPA 2.1 features already pin down most of the appearance, so the denoiser’s effective conditional distribution is nearly unimodal and its sampling path nearly straight. For streaming generation we keep the same local-window KV cache as the predictor ( Appendix H ) and write each new frame’s keys/values only on the last DDIM step so the cache never holds noisy activations; the streaming sampler runs at 4 4 DDIM steps per new frame, the small overhead buying robustness to the cache turnover. AOT compilation of D ϕ D_{\phi} for offline visualization is described alongside the predictor’s compilation pipeline in Appendix I ; all decoder hyperparameters are collected in Table 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管训练时使用了 K = 1000 K{=}1000 个 DDPM 步骤，但在推理阶段，我们仅运行 2 个 DDIM 步骤（Song et al., 2021），从每个 Cosmos 帧的 x_{K-1}\!\sim\!\mathcal{N}(0,I) 开始，并将结果通过冻结的 Cosmos 解码器转换为像素。 我们将此归因于 V-JEPA 条件约束的强大性：密集的 V-JEPA 2.1 特征已经锁定了大部分外观信息，因此去噪器的有效条件分布几乎呈单峰态，其采样路径也近乎笔直。 对于流式生成，我们保留与预测器相同的局部窗口 KV 缓存（附录 H），并且仅在最后一个 DDIM 步骤中写入每个新帧的键/值，以确保缓存中从不包含噪声激活；流式采样器每生成一个新帧运行 4 个 DDIM 步骤，这一较小的额外开销增强了缓存刷新时的稳健性。 用于离线可视化的 D_{\phi} 的 AOT 编译在附录 I 中与预测器的编译流程一同进行了描述；所有解码器超参数均汇总于表 11。

paragraphs.en: The planner is sharded data-parallel across G G GPUs: every rank draws its own N samp N_{\mathrm{samp}} samples per refinement iteration and rolls them through its replica of g θ g_{\theta} , using the same shared KV cache trick along the sample axis as on a single GPU. The per-rank rewards and the matching action tensors are then AllGather -ed (line 17 of Algorithm 1 ) so that every rank sees the same global pool of size N samp × G N_{\mathrm{samp}}\times G and can pick the top- k k elites independently and consistently. Because this elite set is selected from the global pool, the elite count k k is decoupled from the per-GPU sample count: in our DROID configuration we use N samp = 16 N_{\mathrm{samp}}{=}16 samples per GPU but k = 20 k{=}20 elites, which would be ill-defined on a single rank but is in fact a k = 20 k{=}20 out of a pool of N samp ⋅ G N_{\mathrm{samp}}\!\cdot\!G ( ≥ 256 \geq 256 in our deployments).
paragraphs.zh: 规划器在 G 个 GPU 上采用分片数据并行方式：每个秩在每次优化迭代中抽取其专属的 N samp N_{\mathrm{samp}} 个样本，并基于其副本中的 g θ g_{\theta} 对这些样本进行推理，同时沿样本轴使用与单 GPU 相同的共享 KV 缓存机制。 随后，各秩的奖励值及对应的动作张量通过 AllGather 操作（算法 1 的第 17 行）进行汇总，使得每个秩都能访问到大小为 N samp × G N_{\mathrm{samp}}\times G 的统一全局样本池，并能够独立且一致地从中挑选前 k 个精英样本。 由于这些精英样本是从全局池中选择的，因此精英数量 k 与每个 GPU 的样本数量解耦：在我们的 DROID 配置中，每个 GPU 使用 N samp = 16 N_{\mathrm{samp}}{=}16 个样本，但精英数量为 k = 20 k{=}20；这一设置在单个秩上会因样本不足而无法定义，但实际上是从大小为 N samp ⋅ G N_{\mathrm{samp}}\!\cdot\!G（在我们的部署中 ≥ 256）的池中选取的 k = 20 个精英样本。

paragraphs.en: which is then scaled by the per-axis std and shifted by the per-step mean before the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -ball projection of Section F.4 . The motivation is twofold. First, with r r uniform on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and angles uniform on [ 0 , 2 ​ π ) [0,2\pi) , the distribution puts noticeable mass at small ‖ u ~ ‖ \|\tilde{u}\| (because the radial coordinate is uniform rather than thrice-folded), which corresponds to “stay close to the warm-started mean” and stabilizes CEM in regimes where the previous plan is already near-optimal. Second, decoupling radius from angles makes the proposal density easy to clip in norm without distorting the angular distribution: the subsequent projection onto an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -ball only renormalizes samples whose radius exceeds ρ max \rho_{\max} , leaving the angular content untouched. Rotation and gripper dimensions, when active, are drawn from a standard isotropic Gaussian and treated identically in the subsequent affine warp by ( μ h , σ h ) (\mu_{h},\sigma_{h}) .
paragraphs.zh: 然后，该值会按各轴标准差进行缩放，并按每步均值进行偏移，之后再进行第 F.4 节的 ℓ₂ -球投影。 其动机有两方面。 首先，当 r 在 [0,1] 上均匀分布且角度在 [0,2π) 上均匀分布时，该分布会在较小的 ‖ũ‖ 处分配显著的质量（因为径向坐标是均匀分布的，而非三倍折叠的），这对应于“保持靠近暖启动均值”，并在先前计划已接近最优的情况下稳定 CEM。 其次，将半径与角度解耦后，可以在不扭曲角度分布的情况下轻松对提议密度进行范数裁剪：随后的 ℓ₂ -球投影只会重新归一化半径超过 ρ_max 的样本，而角度部分则保持不变。 旋转和夹爪尺寸在激活时，会从标准各向同性高斯分布中抽取，并在后续的仿射变换中由 (μ_h, σ_h) 以相同方式处理。

paragraphs.en: After the affine warp a h ( n ) = μ h + σ h ⊙ a ~ h ( n ) a^{(n)}_{h}=\mu_{h}+\sigma_{h}\odot\tilde{a}^{(n)}_{h} , the translation block is projected onto an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -ball of radius ρ max \rho_{\max} that bounds the per-step end-effector displacement:
paragraphs.zh: 经过仿射变换后，a h ( n ) = μ h + σ h ⊙ a ~ h ( n ) a^{(n)}_{h}=\mu_{h}+\sigma_{h}\odot\tilde{a}^{(n)}_{h}，平移模块被投影到一个半径为 ρ max \rho_{\max} 的 ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -球上，该球限制了每一步末端执行器的位移：

paragraphs.en: The projection enforces a per-step end-effector displacement bound that respects the robot’s velocity limits, regardless of how aggressively an unlucky elite refit inflated the CEM covariance. We use ρ max = 0.05 \rho_{\max}{=}0.05 m on DROID and ρ max = 0.10 \rho_{\max}{=}0.10 m on RoboCasa, matching the per-step delta scales of the corresponding demonstration corpora. Because the projection only fires outside the ball, it leaves the (warm-started) mean direction unbiased and, combined with Equation 17 , keeps the angular content close to uniform after clipping. The gripper dimension, when active, is element-wise clipped to [ − ρ gripper , ρ gripper ] [-\rho_{\mathrm{gripper}},\rho_{\mathrm{gripper}}] rather than projected, since it is a scalar with a different physical meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 该投影强制对每一步末端执行器的位移施加限制，以确保符合机器人的速度极限，无论某个运气不佳的精英重配方案如何将 CEM 协方差膨胀得多么激进。 我们在 DROID 上使用 ρ max = 0.05 \rho_{\max}{=}0.05 m，在 RoboCasa 上使用 ρ max = 0.10 \rho_{\max}{=}0.10 m，这与相应演示数据集的每一步增量尺度相匹配。 由于投影仅在球体外触发，因此它不会改变（热启动后的）平均方向，并且结合方程 17，在裁剪后仍能保持角内容接近均匀分布。 当夹具处于激活状态时，其尺寸会按元素被裁剪至 [ − ρ gripper , ρ gripper ] [-\rho_{\mathrm{gripper}},\rho_{\mathrm{gripper}}]，而不是进行投影，因为这是一个具有不同物理意义的标量。

paragraphs.en: When the world model is conditioned on multiple cameras, the computational cost in Equation 3 is summed across views with configurable per-view weights w v w_{v} , re-using the per-block view conditioning of Section A.2 so that goal patches are compared at the correct viewpoint. Goal images that are unavailable for some views are handled by zeroing the corresponding w v w_{v} at runtime, which lets us re-use the same multi-view checkpoint for single-camera DROID episodes without any retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 当世界模型以多个摄像头为条件时，方程 3 中的计算成本会在不同视角间求和，并可通过配置每个视角的权重 w v w_{v} 进行调整；同时复用了 A.2 节中的每块视角条件设置，从而确保目标图像块在正确的视角下进行比较。 对于某些视角中不可用的目标图像，可以在运行时将对应的 w v w_{v} 置零来处理；这样我们就能在不进行任何重新训练的情况下，复用相同的多视角检查点来运行单摄像头 DROID 任务。

paragraphs.en: Our real-robot experiments run on a Franka Panda arm with a parallel-jaw gripper, controlled through the original DROID software stack ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) . Deployment is split across two machines. A robot-control server runs on the robot PC and exposes the arm and cameras through a simple TCP/ZMQ request–reply interface; the planner client runs on a GPU cluster and connects to this server remotely. This separation lets the planner marshal a large number of GPUs for parallel world-model inference — the CEM optimizer samples and scores thousands of candidate rollouts per step across the cluster — while a single client process is the only one that exchanges observations and actions with the physical robot ( Section G.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的真实机器人实验在一台配备平行夹爪的 Franka Panda 机械臂上运行，并通过原始的 DROID 软件栈进行控制（Khazatsky 等人，2024）。 部署分布在两台机器上。 一个机器人控制服务器运行在机器人电脑上，通过一个简单的 TCP/ZMQ 请求-响应接口提供对机械臂和摄像头的访问；规划器客户端运行在 GPU 集群上，并远程连接到该服务器。 这种分离使得规划器能够调度大量 GPU 进行并行世界模型推理——CEM 优化器在每个步骤中跨整个集群对数千个候选执行序列进行采样和评分——而只有一个客户端进程与物理机器人交换观测结果和行动（G.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The scene is observed by two cameras: one ZED camera mounted on the wrist and one Intel RealSense camera placed externally to the left of the workspace (unlike the multi-ZED upstream DROID rig, we do not use a third camera). The wrist ZED records at 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 and the external RealSense at 480 × 640 480{\times}640 ; both streams are converted to RGB and resized to each agent’s native input resolution ( 240 × 320 240{\times}320 for the RoboJEPA models) before encoding. At deployment RoboJEPA uses the resulting two views — external (left) and wrist.
paragraphs.zh: 场景由两台摄像头进行观察：一台安装在手腕上的 ZED 摄像头，以及一台放置在工作区左侧外部的 Intel RealSense 摄像头（与上游的多 ZED DROID 设备不同，我们没有使用第三台摄像头）。 手腕处的 ZED 以 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 的分辨率录制，外部的 RealSense 则以 480 × 640 480{\times}640 的分辨率录制；在编码之前，两路视频流都会被转换为 RGB 格式，并调整到每个智能体的原始输入分辨率（RoboJEPA 模型为 240 × 320 240{\times}320）。 在部署时，RoboJEPA 使用由此生成的两个视角——外部视角（左侧）和手腕视角。

paragraphs.en: For RoboJEPA we drive the robot with blocking end-effector control rather than a fixed-rate stream: each environment step commands an end-effector delta pose and then waits until the arm and gripper reach the commanded target before the next observation is returned, so the loop is paced by motion completion rather than a fixed control frequency. Although the underlying environment supports the full DROID action interface (7-DoF Cartesian and 8-DoF joint spaces, in velocity or position mode), our planner acts in a reduced space: it plans only 3 3 D end-effector translation together with a 1 1 D gripper command, holding the end-effector orientation fixed. The proprioceptive state we read back is the end-effector pose and gripper opening (with joint angles also available). At each step the planner encodes the current views and state into the world-model latent space, chooses an action by imagining short rollouts and scoring them against a goal image ( Section 2.2 ), executes it, and repeats; each episode begins by homing the arm and recording the goal observation that defines the task. The full planning configuration is given in Section G.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于 RoboJEPA，我们使用阻塞式末端执行器控制来驱动机器人，而不是采用固定频率的数据流：每个环境步都会命令末端执行器的位姿增量，然后等待机械臂和夹具到达所命令的目标位置，之后才会返回下一次观察结果，因此循环的节奏由动作的完成时间决定，而非固定的控制频率。 尽管底层环境支持完整的 DROID 动作接口（7-DoF 笛卡尔空间和 8-DoF 关节空间，支持速度或位置模式），但我们的规划器在简化后的空间中运行：它仅规划 3D 的末端执行器平移和 1D 的夹具命令，同时保持末端执行器的朝向固定。 我们读取回来的本体感觉状态包括末端执行器的位姿和夹具的开度（关节角度也可获取）。 在每个步骤中，规划器将当前的视角和状态编码到世界模型潜在空间中，通过想象短期动作序列并将其与目标图像进行评分来选择动作（第 2.2 节），然后执行该动作并重复此过程；每个回合开始时都会将机械臂归零，并记录定义任务的目标观察结果。 完整的规划配置见第 G.3 节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three tasks on the Franka/DROID platform: Grasp, Object Lift, and Pick and Place. Grasp requires the robot to grasp the object. Object Lift requires the robot to hold the object lifted in the air until the end of the episode. Pick and Place requires the object to end up at the target position, regardless of how many times it was dropped during the episode. These completion criteria do not imply one another: success on Pick and Place does not require satisfying the Object Lift criterion. Goal and initial observations for all three tasks are shown in Section G.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Franka/DROID 平台上评估了三项任务：抓取、物体提升以及取放。 抓取任务要求机器人抓住物体。 物体提升任务要求机器人将物体举在空中并保持直到回合结束。 取放任务要求物体最终到达目标位置，无论其在回合期间被掉落多少次。 这些完成标准之间并无相互依赖关系：完成取放任务并不一定需要满足物体提升的标准。 所有三项任务的目标和初始观察信息均见 G.6 节。

paragraphs.en: For each model–task combination, we run 30 30 episodes for RoboJEPA and 50 50 episodes for each VLA baseline. We evaluate RoboJEPA models ranging from 22 22 M to 8 8 B parameters, using the checkpoint trained with the most compute at each size. All RoboJEPA models use the same planning hyperparameters across tasks, including the planning horizon. Hardware and controller details are provided in Section G.1 , and the planning configuration is given in Section G.3 .

Neither RoboJEPA nor the baselines receive task-specific fine-tuning.

The per-model values are reported in Table 12 .

paragraphs.en: Our simulated evaluations use four custom tasks built on top of RoboCasa kitchen scenes ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) with the mobile-base PandaOmron (Franka Panda) robot. The four tasks share the same common controller. We drive the robot with a blocking controller that we implement on top of the simulator: each planner action specifies a target end-effector offset, which the environment servos toward with operational-space control until it converges (or a step cap is reached) before returning the next observation. We further extend the controller to drive the commanded end-effector rotation to convergence: rather than the default operational-space controller, which does not guarantee the orientation reaches its target, our controller feeds back the world-frame rotation error at every sub-step and only terminates once both the position and rotation errors fall below tolerance. We found this rotation convergence to be important for correctly matching the wrist-camera view during planning, since the planner scores candidates by a distance induced by both the side-view and the wrist-view predictions and the wrist camera is rigidly mounted to the end-effector, so any residual orientation drift would misalign the wrist view. RoboCasa exposes a large collection of kitchens split into training and evaluation scenes; the world model is trained on the training kitchens and all four tasks are run in the held-out evaluation kitchens. Because the environment is fully simulated, we can define both the goal image and the reward directly inside it. Every episode is instantiated from up to ten held-out target kitchens (one per layout/style pair), with non-structural countertop appliances near the workspace hidden to reduce clutter. Observations are rendered at 480 × 640 480{\times}640 from the agent-view and, when enabled, wrist cameras. In every task the reward is the normalized progress toward the goal, r t = max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − ∥ x t − x goal ∥ / d 0 ) r_{t}=\max\!\big(0,\,1-\lVert x_{t}-x_{\mathrm{goal}}\rVert/d_{0}\big) , where d 0 d_{0} is the initial goal distance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模拟评估使用了基于 RoboCasa 厨房场景（Nasiriany et al., 2024；Nasiriany et al., 2026）构建的四个自定义任务，并采用具有移动基座的 PandaOmron（Franka Panda）机器人。 这四个任务共享同一个通用控制器。 我们通过一个在模拟器上实现的阻塞控制器来驱动机器人：每个规划器动作都会指定一个末端执行器的目标偏移量，环境会通过操作空间控制将其伺服至该目标，直到收敛（或达到步数上限），然后返回下一个观测值。 我们进一步扩展了该控制器，以将指令的末端执行器旋转驱动至收敛状态：与无法保证朝向达到目标的默认操作空间控制器不同，我们的控制器在每个子步骤中都会反馈世界坐标系下的旋转误差，并且只有当位置和旋转误差均低于容限时才会终止。 我们发现这种旋转收敛对于在规划过程中正确匹配手腕摄像头视角至关重要，因为规划器会根据侧视图和手腕视图预测所引发的距离对候选方案进行评分，而手腕摄像头是刚性安装在末端执行器上的，因此任何残留的朝向漂移都会导致手腕视图失准。 RoboCasa 提供了一系列大型厨房场景，这些场景被划分为训练场景和评估场景；世界模型在训练厨房上进行训练，而所有四个任务都在预留的评估厨房中运行。 由于环境是完全模拟的，我们可以在其中直接定义目标图像和奖励。 每一集都从最多十个预留的目标厨房（每个布局/风格组合对应一个）实例化而来，同时隐藏了工作区附近非结构性的台面设备，以减少杂乱。 观测值以 480 × 640 的分辨率从智能体视角渲染，并在启用时也包括手腕摄像头视角。 在每个任务中，奖励是朝向目标的归一化进度：r t = max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − ∥ x t − x goal ∥ / d 0 ) r_{t}=\max\!\big(0,\,1-\lVert x_{t}-x_{\mathrm{goal}}\rVert/d_{0}\big)，其中 d 0 d_{0} 是初始目标距离。

sents.zh: RoboCasa 提供了一系列大型厨房场景，这些场景被划分为训练场景和评估场景；世界模型在训练厨房上进行训练，而所有四个任务都在预留的评估厨房中运行。

sents.en: Because the environment is fully simulated, we can define both the goal image and the reward directly inside it.
sents.zh: 由于环境是完全模拟的，我们可以在其中直接定义目标图像和奖励。

sents.en: Every episode is instantiated from up to ten held-out target kitchens (one per layout/style pair), with non-structural countertop appliances near the workspace hidden to reduce clutter.
sents.zh: 每一集都从最多十个预留的目标厨房（每个布局/风格组合对应一个）实例化而来，同时隐藏了工作区附近非结构性的台面设备，以减少杂乱。

sents.en: Observations are rendered at 480 × 640 480{\times}640 from the agent-view and, when enabled, wrist cameras.
sents.zh: 观测值以 480 × 640 的分辨率从智能体视角渲染，并在启用时也包括手腕摄像头视角。

sents.en: In every task the reward is the normalized progress toward the goal, r t = max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − ∥ x t − x goal ∥ / d 0 ) r_{t}=\max\!\big(0,\,1-\lVert x_{t}-x_{\mathrm{goal}}\rVert/d_{0}\big) , where d 0 d_{0} is the initial goal distance.
sents.zh: 在每个任务中，奖励是朝向目标的归一化进度：r t = max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − ∥ x t − x goal ∥ / d 0 ) r_{t}=\max\!\big(0,\,1-\lVert x_{t}-x_{\mathrm{goal}}\rVert/d_{0}\big)，其中 d 0 d_{0} 是初始目标距离。

paragraphs.en: The robot must move its end-effector from a randomly sampled start pose to a randomly sampled goal pose in the kitchen. We remove all objects from the scene so that nothing occludes the path from the start to the goal. Start and goal are drawn uniformly within a small ball around the robot’s home pose and rejection-sampled so that they lie a fixed distance apart ( 0.25 0.25 – 0.35 0.35 m) and are reachable without a large reorientation of the end-effector. This task isolates the world model’s ability to predict free-space end-effector motion across kitchens. Figure 27 shows example goal and initial observations.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人必须将其末端执行器从厨房中随机采样的初始姿态移动至随机采样的目标姿态。 我们从场景中移除了所有物体，以确保从初始姿态到目标姿态的路径没有任何遮挡。 初始姿态和目标姿态在围绕机器人初始位置的一个小球内均匀采样，并通过拒绝采样确保两者之间保持固定距离（0.25–0.35米），且无需对末端执行器进行大幅重新定向即可到达。 这项任务专门检验世界模型预测末端执行器在不同厨房环境中自由空间运动的能力。 图27展示了目标姿态和初始观测值的示例。

paragraphs.en: A harder variant of Reach: one appliance (by default a coffee machine) is kept in the scene and repositioned directly in front of the robot, and the start and goal are constrained to lie on opposite sides of it. The end-effector must therefore arc around the obstacle rather than travel in a straight line, and the reachable distance band is widened ( 0.25 0.25 – 0.50 0.50 m). It tests whether the planner can find collision-free trajectories through the world model. Figure 28 shows an example episode.
paragraphs.zh: Reach 的一个更难变体：场景中保留一件设备（默认为咖啡机），并将其直接重新定位到机器人正前方，同时起点和终点被限制在该设备的两侧。 因此，末端执行器必须绕过障碍物进行弧形移动，而不是沿直线行进，并且可达距离带被加宽（0.25–0.50 米）。 该测试旨在检验规划器能否通过世界模型找到无碰撞的轨迹。 图 28 展示了一个示例过程。

paragraphs.en: Here the robot must perform a reach while holding an object. To set this up, we first grasp the object with a heuristic scripted agent: a small Python controller that executes a top-down grasp (approach, descend, close, and lift) inside the simulator. Running the grasp in simulation ensures the object is held in a physically correct way before planning begins. The world model then has to move the held object to a randomly sampled goal position, and the reward is the normalized progress of the object toward its goal rather than of the end-effector. The object is one of a banana, a can, or a mug, which differ in shape and physical properties (friction and grasp offsets are tuned per object). Figures 29 , 30 and 31 show examples for the three objects.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，机器人必须在手持物体的同时执行抓取动作。 为实现这一设置，我们首先使用一个启发式脚本智能体来抓取物体：这是一个小型 Python 控制器，在模拟器中执行自上而下的抓取动作（接近、下降、闭合和抬起）。 在模拟环境中执行抓取动作，可以确保在规划开始前，物体以物理上正确的方式被握住。 随后，世界模型需要将握住的物体移动到一个随机采样的目标位置，奖励则基于物体朝向其目标的归一化进度，而非末端执行器的进度。 物体可以是香蕉、罐头或马克杯，它们在形状和物理特性（摩擦力和抓取偏移量会针对每个物体进行调整）上有所不同。 图 29、30 和 31 展示了这三种物体的示例。

sents.zh: 在此，机器人必须在手持物体的同时执行抓取动作。

paragraphs.en: The robot must push the object across the counter by contact from a randomly sampled start position to a randomly sampled goal position. The gripper is held closed so that it acts as a solid pusher, and the arm is driven by translation deltas, so the object moves only through contact rather than being grasped. Start and goal are sampled a fixed distance apart ( 0.10 0.10 – 0.15 0.15 m) within a small disk on the counter; because forward pushes (along the robot’s reach direction) are far more reliable than lateral ones, the push direction is restricted to a 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} cone around the forward axis. As in ObjectReach, the reward is the normalized progress of the object toward its goal. This task probes whether the world model captures non-prehensile, contact-rich dynamics. Figure 32 shows example goal and initial observations.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体必须通过接触，将物体从随机采样的起始位置推过操作台，到达随机采样的目标位置。 夹爪保持闭合状态，从而起到实心推杆的作用；机械臂则通过平移增量驱动，因此物体仅通过接触移动，而非被抓取。 起始点和目标点以固定间距（0.10–0.15 米）在操作台上的一个小圆盘内采样；由于沿智能体可达方向的前向推动比侧向推动可靠得多，推动方向被限制在围绕前向轴的一个 60° 的锥形区域内。 与 ObjectReach 任务类似，奖励是物体朝向目标所取得的归一化进展。 该任务旨在检验世界模型是否能够捕捉到非抓取、以接触为主的动态过程。 图 32 展示了目标位置和初始观测值的示例。

sents.zh: 图 32 展示了目标位置和初始观测值的示例。

paragraphs.en: All four RoboCasa tasks are solved with the same closed-loop CEM planner ( Section 2.2 , Algorithm 1 ). Across the four tasks the only CEM hyperparameter we vary is the predictor horizon H H ; every other CEM setting is shared ( Table 14 , top). Push uses the same planning configuration as ObstacleReach. As in the DROID configuration ( Table 13 ) the planner scores rollouts by per-token ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance to the goal features and re-plans after every executed action. Reach and ObstacleReach and Push search over 3 3 D end-effector translation, while ObjectReach first grasps an object with a scripted agent and then additionally searches the gripper. The tasks otherwise differ in their environment configuration ( Table 14 , bottom).
paragraphs.zh: 所有四个 RoboCasa 任务都使用相同的闭环 CEM 规划器（第 2.2 节，算法 1）进行求解。 在这四个任务中，我们唯一变化的 CEM 超参数是预测者时域 H；其他所有 CEM 设置均保持一致（表 14，顶部）。 Push 任务使用与 ObstacleReach 相同的规划配置。 与 DROID 配置（表 13）一样，该规划器通过每个标记到目标特征的 ℓ₁ 距离对展开序列进行评分，并在每次执行动作后重新规划。 Reach、ObstacleReach 和 Push 任务在三维末端执行器平移空间中进行搜索，而 ObjectReach 则首先通过一个脚本智能体抓取物体，然后进一步对夹具进行搜索。 除此之外，这些任务在环境配置上有所不同（表 14，底部）。

sents.zh: Push 任务使用与 ObstacleReach 相同的规划配置。

sents.en: As in the DROID configuration ( Table 13 ) the planner scores rollouts by per-token ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance to the goal features and re-plans after every executed action.

sents.zh: Reach、ObstacleReach 和 Push 任务在三维末端执行器平移空间中进行搜索，而 ObjectReach 则首先通过一个脚本智能体抓取物体，然后进一步对夹具进行搜索。

paragraphs.en: We observe qualitative differences in the behavior induced by planning with small and large world models. Small models’ main weakness is poor gripper control, yet their successful episodes exhibit smooth end-effector trajectories and accurate approaches to objects. They struggle to recover after approaching an object from an unsuitable grasping position, whereas larger models can adapt and recover from such mistakes. As model size increases, behavior gradually shifts from smooth execution relying on a single grasping attempt toward more adaptive and robust execution. Intermediate models, such as the 300 300 M and 1 1 B variants, appear to lie between these behavioral regimes, combining some of the limitations of smaller models with emerging recovery capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，使用小型和大型世界模型进行规划所引发的行为存在定性差异。 小型模型的主要弱点是抓取器控制能力较差，但它们在成功执行的任务中展现出平滑的末端执行器轨迹以及对物体的精准接近。 当从不适合抓取的位置接近物体时，它们难以恢复；而较大的模型则能够适应并从此类错误中恢复过来。 随着模型规模的增大，其行为逐渐从依赖单次抓取尝试的流畅执行，转变为更具适应性和鲁棒性的执行方式。 中等规模的模型（如 300 300 M 和 1 1 B 变体）似乎介于这两种行为模式之间，既保留了小型模型的部分局限性，也具备了一些初步的恢复能力。

sents.en: We observe qualitative differences in the behavior induced by planning with small and large world models.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，使用小型和大型世界模型进行规划所引发的行为存在定性差异。

sents.en: Small models’ main weakness is poor gripper control, yet their successful episodes exhibit smooth end-effector trajectories and accurate approaches to objects.
sents.zh: 小型模型的主要弱点是抓取器控制能力较差，但它们在成功执行的任务中展现出平滑的末端执行器轨迹以及对物体的精准接近。

sents.en: They struggle to recover after approaching an object from an unsuitable grasping position, whereas larger models can adapt and recover from such mistakes.
sents.zh: 当从不适合抓取的位置接近物体时，它们难以恢复；而较大的模型则能够适应并从此类错误中恢复过来。

sents.en: As model size increases, behavior gradually shifts from smooth execution relying on a single grasping attempt toward more adaptive and robust execution.
sents.zh: 随着模型规模的增大，其行为逐渐从依赖单次抓取尝试的流畅执行，转变为更具适应性和鲁棒性的执行方式。

sents.en: Intermediate models, such as the 300 300 M and 1 1 B variants, appear to lie between these behavioral regimes, combining some of the limitations of smaller models with emerging recovery capabilities.
sents.zh: 中等规模的模型（如 300 300 M 和 1 1 B 变体）似乎介于这两种行为模式之间，既保留了小型模型的部分局限性，也具备了一些初步的恢复能力。

paragraphs.en: When comparing RoboJEPA with the VLA reference models, we cannot fully disentangle the contribution of image-goal specification from that of world-model scaling. The differences in training data and controller interfaces described in Section G.1 also limit this comparison. Nevertheless, all RoboJEPA model sizes use the same goal specification and planning configuration, and the observed improvement across sizes suggests that model scaling contributes to the capabilities of the resulting planner. These qualitative observations complement the task progress and success rates reported in Table 12 .
paragraphs.zh: 在将 RoboJEPA 与 VLA 参考模型进行比较时，我们无法完全区分图像目标指定与世界模型扩展各自所做出的贡献。 G.1 节中描述的训练数据和控制器接口的差异也限制了这种比较。 尽管如此，所有 RoboJEPA 模型规模都使用了相同的目标指定和规划配置，而不同规模之间观察到的性能提升表明，模型扩展对最终规划器的能力有所贡献。 这些定性观察结果补充了表 12 中报告的任务进展和成功率。

sents.en: When comparing RoboJEPA with the VLA reference models, we cannot fully disentangle the contribution of image-goal specification from that of world-model scaling.
sents.zh: 在将 RoboJEPA 与 VLA 参考模型进行比较时，我们无法完全区分图像目标指定与世界模型扩展各自所做出的贡献。

sents.en: The differences in training data and controller interfaces described in Section G.1 also limit this comparison.

paragraphs.en: As prediction advances, the rolling cache replaces the oldest frame with the new one. RoPE uses absolute timestep indices, so cached positions do not need to be renumbered when the buffer wraps. Each new frame attends only to the retained window, keeping the amount of cached history bounded even for long rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 随着预测的推进，滚动缓存会用新帧替换最旧的帧。 RoPE 使用绝对时间步索引，因此缓冲区循环时，缓存的位置无需重新编号。 每个新帧仅关注保留的窗口，从而即使长时间运行，也能使缓存的历史信息量保持有限。

paragraphs.en: At the start of each planning call, we process the observation context once and share its cached keys and values across the CEM candidates. Subsequent predictions maintain candidate-specific caches because their action sequences differ. This avoids repeatedly processing the same observation history, while each prediction step processes only the new tokens and attends to a fixed-size window of cached tokens. The compilation pipeline is described in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 在每次规划调用的开始，我们会对观察上下文进行一次处理，并在 CEM 候选者之间共享其缓存的键值对。 后续预测会维持每个候选者专属的缓存，因为它们的动作序列各不相同。 这样既能避免重复处理相同的观察历史，又能确保每个预测步骤仅处理新出现的词元，并关注固定大小的缓存词元窗口。 编译流程在附录 I 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: Expands Section 2.2 . The story of the inference engine is one long descent: start from the V-JEPA 2-AC ( Assran et al., 2025 ) eager BF16 baseline, identify what binds it (host-side dispatch, not arithmetic; Section I.1 ), unbind it with PyTorch Inductor lowering and ahead-of-time compilation that also makes cold start usable on a robot ( Section I.2 ), then squeeze the remaining matmul time with a static FP8 path on top ( Section I.3 ). Section I.4 records the roads we abandoned because the workload simply was not where they help. All numbers are wall-clock measurements on a single NVIDIA H200 (140 GB HBM3) running PyTorch 2.9, on the 1 B predictor at 240p with grouped-query attention (12 query heads, 4 KV heads, 40 layers, 1536 hidden dim), and the rolling KV cache of L cache = 8 L_{\mathrm{cache}}{=}8 frames.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展第 2.2 节。 推理引擎的故事就是一场漫长的下探：从 V-JEPA 2-AC（Assran 等人，2025）的 eager BF16 基线开始，确定其性能瓶颈所在（主机端的调度而非算术运算；见第 I.1 节），通过 PyTorch Inductor 的 lowering 和提前编译将其解除限制，这也使得冷启动在机器人上变得可行（见第 I.2 节），然后借助顶层的静态 FP8 路径进一步压缩剩余的 matmul 时间（见第 I.3 节）。 第 I.4 节记录了那些我们放弃的道路，因为工作负载根本不在这些方法能发挥作用的领域。 所有数据均为单台 NVIDIA H200（140 GB HBM3）上运行 PyTorch 2.9 的墙钟时间测量结果，测试对象为 1 B 预测器，在 240p 分辨率下使用分组查询注意力机制（12 个查询头、4 个 KV 头、40 层、1536 维隐藏层），并采用 L cache = 8 L_{\mathrm{cache}}{=}8 帧的滚动 KV 缓存。

paragraphs.en: At steady state ( B = 16 B{=}16 , full KV cache, 2-view) GEMMs take only ∼ 26 % {\sim}26\% of GPU time, attention ∼ 41 % {\sim}41\% , and fused pointwise ops (RoPE, GELU, normalizations, cache management) the remaining ∼ 33 % {\sim}33\% ; on top of that, eager mode burns ∼ 31 % {\sim}31\% of wall time in dispatch overhead. Doubling GEMM throughput would buy at most a 1.21 × 1.21\times end-to-end factor; removing dispatch and fusing the long pointwise tail are the first-order wins. At B = 1 B{=}1 the same decomposition is even more dispatch-dominated ( ∼ 47 % {\sim}47\% of wall time), which is why the headline speedups in Section 2.2 are largest at small batch. Per-step kernel share within a single rollout is dominated by attention growing with cache occupancy: at step 0 0 attention is ∼ 14 % {\sim}14\% of step time; at step 4 4 ∼ 32 % {\sim}32\% ; at full cache (step 7 + 7^{+} ) ∼ 41 % {\sim}41\% . GEMM time stays roughly constant at ∼ 25 {\sim}25 ms per step regardless of cache depth. This is the computational-cost picture that the rest of the engine targets.
paragraphs.zh: 在稳态下（B = 16 B{=}16，完整的 KV 缓存，2-view），GEMM 仅占用 GPU 时间的 ∼ 26 % {\sim}26\%，注意力机制占用 ∼ 41 % {\sim}41\%，而融合的点运算操作（RoPE、GELU、归一化和缓存管理）则占据剩余的 ∼ 33 % {\sim}33\%；此外，即时模式在调度开销上还会消耗约 ∼ 31 % {\sim}31\% 的实际运行时间。 将 GEMM 吞吐量翻倍最多只能带来 1.21 × 1.21\times 的端到端性能提升；消除调度开销并融合冗长的点运算尾部操作是首要的优化方向。 在 B = 1 B{=}1 时，同样的分解方式甚至更受调度开销主导（实际运行时间中约 ∼ 47 % {\sim}47\%），这也是第 2.2 节中主要加速效果在小批量时最显著的原因。 单次展开过程中每一步的核函数占比主要由随缓存占用量增长的注意力机制决定：在第 0 步，注意力机制约占步骤时间的 ∼ 14 % {\sim}14\%；在第 4 步，约为 ∼ 32 % {\sim}32\%；在满缓存状态（第 7 步及以后，step 7 + 7^{+}），则达到 ∼ 41 % {\sim}41\%。 无论缓存深度如何，GEMM 时间都大致保持恒定，约为每步 ∼ 25 {\sim}25 ms。 这就是引擎其余部分所针对的计算成本图景。

paragraphs.en: The natural answer to dispatch overhead is to lower the per-step graph into fused Triton kernels with PyTorch Inductor ( Ansel et al., 2024 ) . A JIT torch.compile path does this, but it specializes into many shape variants on the first call; we measure 15 15 – 20 20 minutes of warm-up at robot start per autoregressive step pattern , which is incompatible with closed-loop deployment where the operator turns the robot on and expects it to plan in seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 减少调度开销的自然方法是，使用 PyTorch Inductor 将每一步的图结构转换为融合后的 Triton 内核（Ansel 等人，2024）。 JIT torch.compile 路径可以实现这一点，但它在第一次调用时会根据多种形状特化生成多个版本；我们测得机器人启动时，每个自回归步模式需要 15–20 分钟的预热时间，这与闭环部署不兼容——在闭环部署中，操作员只需打开机器人，并期望它能在几秒钟内完成规划。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive predictor inference, however, has a small predictable shape set. At step k k with batch size B B , every tensor shape is fully determined; the rolling cache has only 9 9 distinct configurations (steps 0 0 – 7 7 grow the cache; step 8 8 overwrites the oldest entry and repeats forever). With six compiled batch sizes B ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } B\in\{1,2,4,8,16,32\} this produces 54 54 static programs for the predictor; the diffusion decoder of Section 2.3 compiles to an analogous family of programs through the same pipeline. Each program is exported with torch.export under static shapes and packaged via torch._inductor.aoti_compile_and_package into a 30 30 – 50 50 MB compiled C++ artefact.

paragraphs.en: The static-shape lowering has two prerequisites that drive engineering choices upstream. First, a mutation-free cache: torch.export ’s functionalisation rewrites in-place slices into hundreds of aten.copy ops, which inflated GPU buffer count by ∼ 5 × {\sim}5\times in our first pass. We thread a functional cache through every block (each block reads the input cache tensors and returns fresh ones, the per-layer outputs are stacked, and a wrapper module bakes cache_size and input_position as compile-time constants). The functional path produces bitwise-identical outputs to the in-place version across all cache regimes (empty, mid, full). Second, shared weight tensors across programs : because the ∼ \sim 2 2 GB BF16 weight set is held once rather than once per program, this drops resident memory from ∼ \sim 108 GB to ∼ 14 {\sim}14 GB — the difference between fitting and not fitting on the deployment box. Non-compiled batch sizes are padded up to the nearest compiled value (e.g. B = 3 → 4 B{=}3\to 4 ) and sliced back on output, so the worst-case waste from bucketing is ∼ 50 % {\sim}50\% when the requested B B is just above a compiled size.
paragraphs.zh: 静态形状下推有两个前提条件，这些条件会影响上游的工程决策。 首先，需要一个无突变的缓存：torch.export 的功能化实现将原地切片重写为数百个 aten.copy 操作，这在我们第一次尝试中使 GPU 缓冲区数量增加了约 5 倍（{\sim}5\times）。 我们在每个块中都穿插使用功能化缓存（每个块读取输入缓存张量并返回新的张量，各层的输出会被堆叠，而一个包装模块会将 cache_size 和 input_position 作为编译时常量固化）。 在所有缓存状态（空、中等、满）下，功能化路径产生的输出与原地版本在比特层面完全一致。 其次，跨程序共享权重张量：由于约 2 GB 的 BF16 权重集只需保留一次，而不是每个程序保留一次，因此驻留内存从约 108 GB 降至约 14 GB——这恰好是部署设备能否容纳的关键差异。 未编译的批量大小会被填充到最近的编译值（例如： B = 3 → 4 B{=}3\to 4），并在输出时再次切片，因此分桶造成的最坏情况浪费约为 50%（{\sim}50\%），当请求的 B 略高于某个编译尺寸时尤为明显。

sents.en: Second, shared weight tensors across programs : because the ∼ \sim 2 2 GB BF16 weight set is held once rather than once per program, this drops resident memory from ∼ \sim 108 GB to ∼ 14 {\sim}14 GB — the difference between fitting and not fitting on the deployment box.

paragraphs.en: End-to-end the AOT pipeline yields a 7 × 7\times reduction in launched kernels ( 8 , → 1,291 8{,}975\!\to\!1{,}291 for the 1-view predictor), a 1.8 × 1.8\times GPU compute speedup from better fusion, and a 23 × 23\times reduction in dispatch overhead ( Table 15 ). Crucially, cold start collapses from 15 15 – 20 20 minutes (JIT) to 1.2 1.2 – 1.5 1.5 seconds: the time to load the 54 54 .pt2 files and inject the shared weights. The computational cost of offline compilation ( 40 40 – 60 60 minutes total, parallelised across multiple H200s by an offline compiler) is paid once per checkpoint; thereafter the runtime dispatcher loads the compiled archives and routes each step() call to the matching program. Inside the AOT pipeline we keep one positive low-level result that the failed-attempts ledger would otherwise hide: native GQA dispatched to FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2024 ) avoids the implicit repeat_interleave expansion that the cuDNN attention path uses, contributing the ∼ \sim 3 % 3\% on top that survives in the headline recipe.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端的 AOT 流程使启动的核函数数量减少了 7 × 7\times（对于单视图预测器，从 8 , → 1,291 8{,}975\!\to\!1{,}291），通过更优的融合实现了 1.8 × 1.8\times 的 GPU 计算加速，并将调度开销减少了 23 × 23\times（表 15）。 关键在于，冷启动时间从 15 15 – 20 20 分钟（JIT）缩短至 1.2 1.2 – 1.5 1.5 秒：即加载 54 54 个 .pt2 文件和注入共享权重所需的时间。 离线编译的计算成本（总计 40 40 – 60 60 分钟，由离线编译器在多个 H200 上并行执行）在每个检查点仅支付一次；此后，运行时调度器会加载已编译的存档，并将每个 step() 调用路由到对应的程序。 在 AOT 流程中，我们保留了一个原本会被失败尝试记录表所掩盖的低层积极成果：通过 FlashAttention（Dao et al., 2022; Dao, 2024）调度的原生 GQA 避免了 cuDNN 注意力路径所使用的隐式 repeat_interleave 扩展，从而贡献了最终方案中保留的 ∼ \sim 3 % 3\% 的额外性能。

paragraphs.en: After AOT removes dispatch, what remains is steady-state GEMM and attention time. We can shave a final factor by running the predictor’s linear layers in FP8. Because the workload is not matmul-bound, this is genuinely a small lever — which is itself the data point that justifies the engineering: order wins, not low-precision arithmetic. The FP8 path ( Table 16 ) runs through torch.compile(fullgraph=True) rather than the AOTI path because the AOTI loader currently mishandles many co-resident FP8 programs; the JIT path with the Inductor disk cache is instant after the first compile. Activation scales are calibrated once on a small held-out set and stored as fixed buffers; weights are kept as float8_e4m3fn with fast-accumulate FP8 GEMMs. Outputs match the BF16 reference to within the spatial-sensitivity benchmark’s noise floor ( Section 3.2 ). Table 16 reports per-cache-step latency at B = 16 B{=}16 on the 2-view model: the FP8 advantage is largest at low cache occupancy where the GEMM share is relatively higher; once attention dominates at full cache it shrinks to ∼ 5 % {\sim}5\% .
paragraphs.zh: 在 AOT 移除调度后，剩下的就是稳态的 GEMM 和注意力时间。 通过将预测器的线性层以 FP8 运行，我们可以进一步节省一个最终因子。 由于该工作负载并非受矩阵乘法限制，这确实是一个影响较小的手段——而这一点本身正是支持该工程设计的依据：顺序更为关键，而非低精度算术运算。 FP8 路径（表 16）通过 torch.compile(fullgraph=True) 执行，而非 AOTI 路径，因为当前的 AOTI 加载器无法正确处理许多共存的 FP8 程序；而使用 Inductor 磁盘缓存的 JIT 路径在首次编译后即可即时运行。 激活值标度在一次基于小型预留数据集的校准后作为固定缓冲区存储；权重则以 float8_e4m3fn 格式保留，并使用支持快速累加的 FP8 GEMM 操作。 输出结果与 BF16 参考结果的差异在空间敏感性基准测试的噪声阈值（第 3.2 节）范围内。 表 16 报告了在 B = 16 B{=}16 条件下、双视图模型上每个缓存步骤的延迟：在低缓存占用率时，FP8 的优势最大，此时 GEMM 所占比例相对较高；一旦在满缓存状态下注意力成为主导因素，该优势会缩小至约 5% {\sim}5\%。

paragraphs.en: We document the negative results because they sharpen the picture of what the dominant computational cost actually is.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录这些负面结果，因为它们有助于更清晰地揭示主导性计算成本究竟是什么。

paragraphs.en: A first FP8 attempt with per-call activation amax computation was slower than BF16 ( 177 177 ms vs. ∼ 100 {\sim}100 ms): the three extra ops per linear (cast to FP32, amax reduction, quantise) have a higher computational cost than the FP8 GEMM saves on a model that is not matmul-bound. Static, pre-calibrated scales ( Section I.3 ) eliminate this overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 首次尝试使用每次调用激活 amax 计算的 FP8 格式比 BF16 更慢（177 177 毫秒 vs. ∼ 100 {\sim}100 毫秒）：每个线性层中增加的三个操作（转换为 FP32、amax 归约和量化）所带来的计算成本，高于在非矩阵乘法受限模型上 FP8 GEMM 所节省的成本。 静态的、预先校准好的缩放因子（第 I.3 节）可以消除这种额外开销。

sents.en: A first FP8 attempt with per-call activation amax computation was slower than BF16 ( 177 177 ms vs. ∼ 100 {\sim}100 ms): the three extra ops per linear (cast to FP32, amax reduction, quantise) have a higher computational cost than the FP8 GEMM saves on a model that is not matmul-bound.

sents.zh: 静态的、预先校准好的缩放因子（第 I.3 节）可以消除这种额外开销。

paragraphs.en: The torchao implementations were either incompatible with the dispatcher’s requirement that linear outputs match the BF16 KV-cache dtype required by FlashAttention, or produced ∼ 2 × {\sim}2\times slower forwards because dequantisation overhead dominates on a compute-bound (not bandwidth-bound) model.
paragraphs.zh: torchao 的实现要么与调度器的要求不兼容——即线性输出必须与 FlashAttention 所需的 BF16 KV-cache 数据类型匹配；要么由于解量化开销在计算密集型（而非带宽密集型）模型中占主导地位，导致前向推理速度慢了约 2 倍（{\sim}2\times）。

paragraphs.en: Reduce-overhead capture segfaults inside the captured graph because the KV cache slice assignment mutates a GPU tensor whose target offset changes between replays. A clone-based workaround runs but is slower ( 96 96 ms vs. 91 91 ms) than the non-graph path: once AOT has reduced dispatch overhead to ∼ 3 {\sim}3 ms there is essentially nothing left for graph capture to amortise.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 KV 缓存切片分配会修改一个 GPU 张量，而该张量的目标偏移量在不同重播之间会发生变化，因此需要减少捕获图中因开销过大而导致的段错误。 一种基于克隆的变通方法虽然可行，但比非图路径更慢（96 96 毫秒对比 91 91 毫秒）：一旦 AOT 将调度开销降低到约 3 {\sim}3 毫秒后，捕获图基本上就没什么可摊销的了。

sents.en: Reduce-overhead capture segfaults inside the captured graph because the KV cache slice assignment mutates a GPU tensor whose target offset changes between replays.

paragraphs.en: Both whole-model and per-block TensorRT wrappers were slower ( 0.5 0.5 – 0.7 × 0.7\times ) and produced incorrect outputs, tripping a known multi-output-export bug. AOT Inductor already produces near-optimal fused Triton kernels for this architecture, so TensorRT did not add value.
paragraphs.zh: 整个模型和每个块的 TensorRT 包装器都更慢（0.5–0.7 倍），并生成了错误的输出，触发了一个已知的多输出导出错误。 AOT Inductor 已经为该架构生成了接近最优的融合 Triton 内核，因此 TensorRT 并未带来额外价值。

paragraphs.en: Pre-computing cos/sin tables as registered buffers gave 0 % 0\% speedup under AOT, because Inductor already fuses RoPE inline into its surrounding Triton kernels.
paragraphs.zh: 将 cos/sin 表预计算为已注册的缓冲区在 AOT 下带来了 0% 0\% 的速度提升，因为 Inductor 已经将 RoPE 内联融合到其周围的 Triton 内核中。

paragraphs.en: sdpa_cudnn is 2.4 × 2.4\times faster than xformers_fmha in isolation but only ∼ 3 % {\sim}3\% faster in the AOT pipeline: torch.export captures all SDPA variants as the same ATen op and AOT Inductor lowers to flash-attention regardless of context-manager hint. The native-GQA-without- repeat_interleave factor that survives is reported as part of the AOT pipeline ( Section I.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在独立使用时，sdpa_cudnn 比 xformers_fmha 快 2.4 × 2.4\times，但在 AOT 流程中仅快约 ∼ 3 % {\sim}3\%：torch.export 将所有 SDPA 变体都捕获为相同的 ATen op，而 AOT Inductor 无论上下文管理器提示如何，都会将其降级为 flash-attention。 保留下来的 native-GQA-without- repeat_interleave 因子作为 AOT 流程的一部分被报告（第 I.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: For each episode we pick a random starting timestep, encode its initial observation, and roll the predictor forward for nine steps under the recorded action sequence, giving a ten-step sequence including the initial observation. We then encode the corresponding ground truth future frames and average the L 1 L_{1} distance between predicted and encoder features at each token over the rollout. We average this over roughly 1,024 episodes with randomized starting timesteps.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个回合中，我们选择一个随机的起始时间步，对其初始观测进行编码，然后根据记录的动作序列将预测模型向前运行九个时间步，从而得到一个包含初始观测的十步序列。 接着，我们对对应的真实未来帧进行编码，并在整个展开过程中计算每个标记处预测特征与编码器特征之间的 L1 距离 L_{1} 的平均值。 我们将这一结果在大约 1,024 个具有随机起始时间步的回合中进行平均。

paragraphs.en: Expands the “Towards better scaling” discussion of Section 3.3 . There we show that spending extra compute only in the final learning-rate annealing (cooldown) phase — resumed from the same flat-LR pretraining checkpoints — improves the world model’s scaling without any new data. paragraphs.en: The main-text Figure 14 plots the combined (DROID + {+} RoboCasa) metric; Figures 36 and 37 break the same comparison down per evaluation suite, and Figures 38 and 39 show the long-horizon training law on its own. On both suites the long-horizon training frontier crosses below the short-horizon training one at ∼ 5 × 10 20 {\sim}5{\times}10^{20} FLOPs and continues to a lower floor, i.e. long-horizon prediction training scales strictly better at large compute budgets, confirming that the imagination scaling law can be improved with compute alone.
paragraphs.zh: 正文中的图 14 绘制了组合（DROID + {+} RoboCasa）指标；图 36 和图 37 按评估套件分别展示了相同的比较，而图 38 和图 39 则单独显示了长期训练定律。 在这两个套件中，长期训练的边界在约 5 × 10²⁰ {\sim}5{\times}10^{20} FLOPs 处低于短期训练的边界，并继续下降至一个更低的水平，也就是说，在较大的计算资源预算下，长期预测训练的表现严格更优，这证实了仅通过增加计算资源即可改进想象力的扩展定律。

paragraphs.en: Underpins the compute axis of Sections 3.1 and 3.3 . The training-compute value C C on every scaling-law plot is accumulated as C = ( per-step FLOPs ) × ( optimizer steps ) C=(\text{per-step FLOPs})\times(\text{optimizer steps}) , so the per-step computational cost of each stage sets the horizontal scale. We compute it for each run from its real configuration (view-group layout, per-cell batch size, resolution grid, view count, rollout steps, and node/GPU count), counting both the forward and backward pass. A single “per step” figure is the total the whole job performs for one optimizer update, and therefore already includes all gradient-accumulation microbatches, all data-parallel replicas, and — for rollout recipes — the autoregressive rollout unrolled over its configured steps. We report compute in PF \mathrm{PF} ( 1 ​ PF = 10 15 1\,\mathrm{PF}=10^{15} FLOPs).

paragraphs.en: RoboJEPA training has three stages with very different per-step computational costs. The long pretraining (flat learning-rate) phase and the short-horizon prediction training cooldown share the same cheap recipe (a short K = 2 K{=}2 rollout at a single 240 × 320 240{\times}320 resolution). The long-horizon prediction training cooldown of Section 3.3 instead uses a K = 10 K{=}10 rollout with a KV cache and mixed 240 × 320 240{\times}320 and 480 × 640 480{\times}640 resolutions, and the DROID 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 finetune ( Section G.1 ) adds three high-resolution views on top of the KV-cached K = 10 K{=}10 rollout. Table 19 gives the per-step computational cost of the two cooldown/pretraining recipes at every model size, and Table 20 compares all three stages at 8 8 B.
paragraphs.zh: RoboJEPA 的训练分为三个阶段，每个阶段的每步计算成本差异很大。 漫长的预训练（固定学习率）阶段和短视预测训练的冷却阶段采用相同的低成本方案（在单一 240 × 320 分辨率下执行一次 K = 2 的 rollout）。 第 3.3 节中的长视预测训练冷却阶段则使用 K = 10 的 rollout，并配合 KV 缓存以及 240 × 320 和 480 × 640 混合分辨率；而 DROID 720 × 1280 的微调（第 G.1 节）则在基于 KV 缓存的 K = 10 rollout 基础上增加了三个高分辨率视图。 表 19 列出了两种冷却/预训练方案在不同模型规模下的每步计算成本，表 20 则对比了所有三个阶段在 8 B 时的表现。

sents.zh: RoboJEPA 的训练分为三个阶段，每个阶段的每步计算成本差异很大。

sents.en: The long pretraining (flat learning-rate) phase and the short-horizon prediction training cooldown share the same cheap recipe (a short K = 2 K{=}2 rollout at a single 240 × 320 240{\times}320 resolution).
sents.zh: 漫长的预训练（固定学习率）阶段和短视预测训练的冷却阶段采用相同的低成本方案（在单一 240 × 320 分辨率下执行一次 K = 2 的 rollout）。

sents.en: The long-horizon prediction training cooldown of Section 3.3 instead uses a K = 10 K{=}10 rollout with a KV cache and mixed 240 × 320 240{\times}320 and 480 × 640 480{\times}640 resolutions, and the DROID 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 finetune ( Section G.1 ) adds three high-resolution views on top of the KV-cached K = 10 K{=}10 rollout.
sents.zh: 第 3.3 节中的长视预测训练冷却阶段则使用 K = 10 的 rollout，并配合 KV 缓存以及 240 × 320 和 480 × 640 混合分辨率；而 DROID 720 × 1280 的微调（第 G.1 节）则在基于 KV 缓存的 K = 10 rollout 基础上增加了三个高分辨率视图。

sents.en: Table 19 gives the per-step computational cost of the two cooldown/pretraining recipes at every model size, and Table 20 compares all three stages at 8 8 B.
sents.zh: 表 19 列出了两种冷却/预训练方案在不同模型规模下的每步计算成本，表 20 则对比了所有三个阶段在 8 B 时的表现。

paragraphs.en: Extracts the compute-optimal frontier of the downstream planning success-rate (reward) curves reported in the visual abstract ( Figure 1 ). This procedure applies to the RoboCasa downstream planning tasks, where higher success rate is better. Every model size contributes many checkpoints, so at a fixed size the (compute, success-rate) pairs are stochastic rather than a single clean curve: evaluation noise and training instabilities give a scatter of points at nearby compute values. Fitting a scaling law requires the compute-optimal upper envelope — the best achievable success rate at each compute — rather than the raw scatter, but the obvious envelope estimators are both unsatisfying. A running maximum over compute is not robust: a single lucky, high-variance checkpoint pulls the envelope up prematurely and the estimate never recovers. Fitting the law to all points instead is dragged toward the mean of the scatter, since many dominated, lower checkpoints outnumber the few near the ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 提取了视觉摘要（图 1）中报告的下游规划成功率（奖励）曲线的计算资源最优前沿。 该流程适用于 RoboCasa 下游规划任务，在这些任务中，更高的成功率更优。 每种模型规模都会产生多个检查点，因此在固定规模下，（计算资源、成功率）的组合是随机的，而非一条清晰单一的曲线：评估噪声和训练不稳定性会导致相近计算资源值处出现点状散布。 拟合缩放定律需要的是计算资源最优的上包络线——即每种计算资源下可达到的最佳成功率——而非原始散布点，但直观的上包络线估计方法都令人不满意。 对计算资源进行滚动最大值计算并不稳健：一个运气好、方差高的检查点就会使上包络线过早上升，且估计值永远无法恢复。 相反，若将定律拟合到所有点上，结果会被拉向散布点的均值，因为数量众多的被支配的低效检查点远多于接近上限的少数检查点。

paragraphs.en: We instead select frontier points with a stochastic upper-envelope procedure that tracks a running estimate of the achievable ceiling and admits only points consistent with it, rejecting downward outliers before they can corrupt the running estimate. Concretely, we pool all (compute, success-rate) pairs ( C i , y i ) (C_{i},y_{i}) across model sizes (higher y y is better) and sort them by ascending compute. The running mean m m and variance v v are initialized from the first three points, which are always kept. Each subsequent point is compared against the current upper trend m − k ​ s m-ks , where s = v s=\sqrt{v} and k ≥ 0 k\geq 0 is a rejection threshold in standard-deviation units: a point is accepted onto the frontier only if it does not fall more than k k standard deviations below the running mean. Accepted points update m m and v v with an exponentially-weighted (West) moving-average and moving-variance update governed by a retention factor α ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \alpha\in(0,1) , so recent frontier points dominate the running estimate while stale ones decay away; rejected points leave m m and v v untouched, so a single downward outlier can neither join the frontier nor bias the trend used to judge later points. The scaling law is then fit only on the resulting frontier set. We use α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9 throughout, with a per-task rejection threshold matched to the four RoboCasa downstream planning tasks of the visual abstract: k ≈ 0.5 k\approx 0.5 for the two shorter-horizon, greedy tasks, a larger k ≈ 2 k\approx 2 for the noisier long-horizon obstacle task, and no rejection ( k → ∞ k\to\infty , all points kept) for the object-push task, reflecting the differing success-rate evaluation noise of each task (short-horizon vs. long-horizon, and whether object interaction is involved).
paragraphs.zh: 我们转而采用一种随机上包络程序来选择前沿点：该程序会持续跟踪可达上限的当前估计值，仅允许与该估计值一致的点通过，并在向下异常点破坏当前估计值之前将其拒绝。 具体来说，我们将所有模型规模下的（计算量，成功率）对（ C i , y i ）（C_{i},y_{i}）汇总起来（y 值越高越好），然后按计算量从小到大的顺序进行排序。 当前均值 m m 和方差 v v 由前三个点初始化，且这三个点始终会被保留。 每个后续点都会与当前的上趋势线 m − k ​ s m-ks 进行比较，其中 s = v s=\sqrt{v}，而 k ≥ 0 k\geq 0 是以标准差为单位的拒绝阈值：只有当该点未低于当前均值超过 k k 个标准差时，它才会被接纳到前沿集中。 被接纳的点会通过指数加权（West）移动平均和移动方差更新来更新 m m 和 v v，其更新过程由保留因子 α ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \alpha\in(0,1) 控制，因此近期的前沿点会主导当前估计值，而过时的点则会逐渐衰减；被拒绝的点则不会改变 m m 和 v v，因此单个向下异常点既无法加入前沿集，也无法影响用于判断后续点的趋势。 随后，缩放定律仅基于最终形成的前沿集进行拟合。 我们在整个过程中均使用 α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9，并为每个任务设置了与之匹配的拒绝阈值，该阈值根据视觉摘要中 RoboCasa 的四个下游规划任务进行调整：对于两个时间跨度较短的贪婪任务，k ≈ 0.5 k\approx 0.5；对于噪声较多的长时间跨度的障碍物任务，k ≈ 2 k\approx 2；而对于物体推动任务，则不进行拒绝（ k → ∞ k\to\infty ，所有点均被保留）。这反映了各项任务在成功率评估噪声上的差异（如短时间跨度与长时间跨度，以及是否涉及物体交互）。

paragraphs.en: The new-point weight ( 1 − α ) (1-\alpha) controls how quickly the running estimate adapts: α \alpha close to 1 1 retains a long memory of past frontier points and adapts slowly, while smaller α \alpha tracks recent points more aggressively. Because m m and v v are updated only on accepted points, the procedure is robust to an arbitrary number of downward outliers at any compute scale, unlike a plain running maximum. A reference implementation is provided in make_plot.py as the function stochastic_envelope .
paragraphs.zh: 新点权重 (1 − α) (1-\alpha) 控制运行估计值的适应速度：接近 1 的 α 会保留对过去前沿点的长期记忆并缓慢适应，而较小的 α 会更积极地追踪近期点。 由于 m 和 v 仅在被接受的点上更新，因此该过程对任意计算规模下的任意数量向下异常值都具有鲁棒性，这与普通的运行最大值不同。 参考实现已在 make_plot.py 中以 stochastic_envelope 函数的形式提供。

paragraphs.en: Initially, we started the project by scaling the predictor on top of the V-JEPA 2 encoder. However, we faced numerous issues and instabilities during training. The predictor often collapsed beyond a certain model size, despite the frozen encoder, and increasing the dataset size often led to training instabilities or sometimes divergence. For both encoders, we worked with image features only. We hypothesize that this behavior can be attributed to the type of features the encoder computes.
paragraphs.zh: 最初，我们通过将预测器构建在 V-JEPA 2 编码器之上来启动该项目。 然而，我们在训练过程中遇到了许多问题和不稳定性。 尽管编码器是冻结的，但预测器在模型规模超过某个阈值后常常崩溃，而增加数据集规模通常会导致训练不稳定，有时甚至出现发散。 对于两种编码器，我们都仅使用了图像特征。 我们推测，这种行为可能与编码器所计算的特征类型有关。

sents.zh: 最初，我们通过将预测器构建在 V-JEPA 2 编码器之上来启动该项目。

sents.en: However, we faced numerous issues and instabilities during training.
sents.zh: 然而，我们在训练过程中遇到了许多问题和不稳定性。

sents.en: The predictor often collapsed beyond a certain model size, despite the frozen encoder, and increasing the dataset size often led to training instabilities or sometimes divergence.
sents.zh: 尽管编码器是冻结的，但预测器在模型规模超过某个阈值后常常崩溃，而增加数据集规模通常会导致训练不稳定，有时甚至出现发散。

sents.en: For both encoders, we worked with image features only.
sents.zh: 对于两种编码器，我们都仅使用了图像特征。

sents.en: We hypothesize that this behavior can be attributed to the type of features the encoder computes.
sents.zh: 我们推测，这种行为可能与编码器所计算的特征类型有关。

paragraphs.en: Table 21 shows that the V-JEPA 2 and V-JEPA 2.1 encoders perform on par on image and video understanding tasks, measured through image and video classification, and V-JEPA 2.1 even obtains a lower reported score on the IntPhys2 intuitive physics task than V-JEPA 2. On the other hand, V-JEPA 2.1 substantially outperforms V-JEPA 2 on dense tasks such as depth estimation and semantic segmentation. Given this large gap, we hypothesize that high-quality dense features are the most important features for scaling robotic world models, even more important than features associated with physical understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 表21显示，V-JEPA 2和V-JEPA 2.1编码器在图像和视频理解任务上的表现相当，这些任务通过图像和视频分类进行评估；此外，V-JEPA 2.1在IntPhys2直观物理任务上的得分甚至低于V-JEPA 2。 另一方面，V-JEPA 2.1在深度估计和语义分割等密集任务上显著优于V-JEPA 2。 鉴于这一巨大差距，我们推测高质量的特征是扩展机器人世界模型最重要的特征，甚至比与物理理解相关的特征更为重要。
